Allah Ta'ala Ibn-e-Rahmat ka bayan farmata hai taake logon par uski buzurgi ayan ho jaye ke usne is pak kalam ko apne bande Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par nazil farmaya hai. Surah Kahf ke shuru mein bhi apni hamd isi andaz se bayan ki hai, yahan apni zaat ka babarakat hona bayan farmaya aur yahi wasf bayan kiya. Yahan lafz 'nazzala' farmaya jis se baar-baar bakasrat utarna sabit hota hai. Jaise farman hai ayat (WAL-KITABILLAZI NAZZALA ALA RASULIHI) (Surah (An-Nisa: 136). Pas pehli kitabon ko lafz 'anzala' se aur is aakhri kitab ko lafz 'nazzala' se tabeer farmana isliye hai ke pehli kitabein ek saath utarti rahin aur Quran-e-Kareem thoda thoda kar ke hasb-e-zarurat utarta raha, kabhi kuch ayatein, kabhi kuch suratein, kabhi kuch ahkaam. Is mein ek badi hikmat yeh bhi thi ke logon ko is par amal karna mushkil na ho aur khoob yaad ho jaye aur maan lene ke liye dil khul jaye. Jaise ke isi surah mein farmaya hai ke kafiron ka ek aitraz yeh bhi hai ke Quran-e-Kareem is Nabi par ek saath kyun na utra? Jawab diya gaya hai ke is tarah isliye utra ke is ke saath teri dil-jami rahe aur hum ne thahra thahra kar nazil farmaya. Yeh jo bhi baat banayenge hum us ka sahih aur jacha tula jawab dein jo khoob mufassal hoga. Yahi wajah hai ke yahan is ayat mein is ka naam 'Furqan' rakha. Isliye ke yeh haq-o-batil mein, hidayat-o-gumrahi mein farq karne wala hai, is se bhalai-burai mein, halal-haram mein tameez hoti hai. Quran-e-Kareem ki yeh pak sifat bayan kar ke jis par Quran utra un ki ek pak sifat bayan ki gayi hai ke woh khaas us ki ibadat mein lage rahne wale hain, us ke mukhlis bande hain. Yeh wasf sab se aala wasf hai, isliye badi badi nematon ke bayan ke mauqe par Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yahi wasf bayan farmaya gaya hai. Jaise Meraj ke mauqe par farmaya ayat (SUBHANALLAZI ASRA BI-ABDIHI LAILAM MINAL MASJIDIL HARAMI ILAL MASJIDIL AQSA ALLAZI BARAKNA HAWLAHU LINURIYAHU MIN AYATINA INNAHU HUWAS-SAMIUL BASIR) (Surah (Al-Isra: 1) aur jaise apni khaas ibadat namaz ke mauqe par farmaya ayat (WA ANNAHU LAMMA QAMA ABDULLAHI YAD'UHU KADU YAKUNUNA ALAIHI LIBADA) (Surah (Al-Jinn: 19). Aur jab banda-e-Allah yani Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ibadat karne khade hote hain, yahi wasf Quran-e-Kareem ke utarne aur aap ke paas buzurg farishte ke aane ke ikram ke bayan karne ke mauqe par bayan farmaya. Phir irshad hua ke is pak kitab ka aap ki taraf utarna isliye hai ke aap tamam jahan ke liye aagah karne wale ban jayen, aisi kitab jo sarasar hikmat-o-hidayat wali hai jo mufassal, mubeen aur muhkam hai jis ke aas paas bhi batil phatak nahin sakta jo Hakim-o-Hamid Allah ki taraf se utari hui hai. Aap is ki tabligh duniya bhar mein kar dein, har surkh-o-safaid ko, har door-o-nazdeek wale ko Allah ke azabon se dara dein, jo bhi aasman ke neeche aur zameen ke upar hai us ki taraf aap ki risalat hai.

Jaise ke khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai, "Main tamam surkh-o-safaid insanon ki taraf bheja gaya hoon." Aur farman hai, "Mujhe paanch baatein aisi di gayi hain jo mujh se pehle kisi Nabi ko nahin di gayi thin, un mein se ek yeh hai ke har Nabi apni apni qoum ki taraf bheja jata raha lekin main tamam duniya ki taraf bheja gaya hoon." Khud Quran mein hai, aayat: (Qul ya ayyuhan-nasu inni rasulullahi ilaikum jami'anilladhi lahu mulkus-samawati wal-ard, la ilaha illa huwa yuhyi wa yumit) (Surah (Al-A'raf: 158). "Ae Nabi! Ailan kar do ke ae duniya ke logo! Main tum sab ki taraf Allah ka paighambar hoon." Phir farmaya ke mujhe Rasool bana kar bhejne wala, mujh par yeh pak kitab utarne wala woh Allah hai jo aasman-o-zameen ka tanha malik hai, jo jis kaam ko karna chahe use keh deta hai ke ho ja, woh usi waqt ho jata hai. Wohi marta aur jalata hai, us ki koi aulad nahin, na us ka koi shareek hai, har cheez us ki makhlooq aur us ki zer-e-parwarish hai. Sab ka Khaliq, Malik, Raziq, Mabood aur Rabb wohi hai. Har cheez ka andaza muqarrar karne wala aur tadbeer karne wala wohi hai.))))

Mushrikon ki halat: Mushrikon ki jahalat bayan ho rahi hai ke woh Khaliq, Malik, Qadir, Mukhtar, Badshah ko chhor kar un ki ibadatein karte hain jo ek machhar ka par bhi nahin bana sakte balkeh woh khud Allah ke banaye hue aur usi ke paida kiye hue hain. Woh apne aap ko bhi kisi nafa nuqsan ke pahunchane ke malik nahin che jayike dusre ka bhala karein ya dusre ka nuqsan karein. Ya dusri koi baat kar sakein, woh apni maut zeest ka ya dobara jee uthne ka bhi ikhtiyar nahin rakhte. Phir apni ibadat karne walon ki in cheezon ke malik woh kaise ho jayenge? Baat yahi hai ke in tamam kamon ka malik Allah hi hai, wahi jalata aur marta hai, wahi apni tamam makhlooq ko Qayamat ke din naye sire se paida karega. Is par yeh kaam mushkil nahin, ek ka paida karna aur sab ko paida karna, ek ko maut ke baad zinda karna aur sab ko karna is par yaksan aur barabar hai. Ek aankh jhapkaane mein is ka pura ho jata hai, sirf ek aawaz ke sath tamam mari hui makhlooq zinda ho kar us ke samne ek chatyal maidan mein khari ho jayegi. Aur aayat mein farmaya hai sirf ek dafa ki ek ibadat hai, us ka chaha hota hai, us ke chahe baghair kuch bhi nahin hota. Woh maa baap se, larki larkon se, adeel, wazeer-o-nazeer se, shareek-o-saheem sab se paak hai. Woh Ahad hai, Samad hai, Walam yulad walam yoolad hai, us ka kufu koi nahin.

Khud fareb mushrik mushrikeen ek jahalat upar ki ayaton mein bayan hui. Jo zaat-e-Ilahi ki nisbat thi. Yahan dusri jahalat bayan ho rahi hai jo zaat-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nisbat hum woh kehte hain ke is Quran ko toh is ne auron ki madad se khud hi jhoot moot ghar liya hai. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai yeh un ka zulm aur jhoot hai jis ke batil hone ka khud unhein bhi ilm hai. Jo kuch kehte hain woh khud apni maloomat ke bhi khilaf kehte hain. Kabhi hank lagane lagte hain ke agli kitabon ke qisse is ne likhwa liye hain wohi subh-o-sham is ki majlis mein parhe ja rahe hain. Yeh jhoot bhi woh hai jis mein kisi ko shak na ho sake is liye ke sirf Ahl-e-Makkah hi nahin balkay duniya jaanti hai ke hamare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ummi thay na likhna jaante thay na parhna. Chalees saal ki nabuwwat se pehle ki zindagi aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki inhi logon mein guzar rahi thi aur woh is tarah ke itni muddat mein ek waqia bhi aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zindagi ka ya ek lamha bhi aisa na tha jis par ungli utha sake. Ek ek wasf aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka woh tha jis par zamana sheeda tha jis par Ahl-e-Makkah rashk karte thay. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aam maqbooliyat aur mehboobiyat buland ikhlaqi aur khush muamlagi itni barhi hui thi ke har ek dil mein aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke liye jagah thi. Aam zabanen aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Amin ke pyare khitab se pukarti thin. Duniya aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke qadmon talay ankhein bichati thi. Kaun sa dil tha jo Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka ghar na ho? Kaun si ankh thi jis mein Ahmad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki izzat na ho? Kaun sa majma tha jis ka zikr-e-khair na ho? Kaun woh shakhs tha jo aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki buzurgi, sadaqat, amanat, neki aur bhalai ka qail na ho? Phir jab ke Allah ki buland tareen izzat se aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) muazzaz kiye gaye, asmani wahi ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) amin banaye gaye, toh sirf baap dadon ki raush ko pamal hote hue dekh kar yeh bewaqoof be-painday lotay ki tarah lurhak gaye, thali ke baingan ki tarah idhar se udhar ho gaye, lagay baatein banane, aur aib joi karne. Lekin jhoot ke paon kahan? Kabhi aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko shair kehte, kabhi sahir, kabhi majnoon aur kabhi kazzab. Hairan thay ke kya kahein aur kis tarah apni jahilana raush ko baqi rakhein aur apne maboodan-e-batil ke jhanday oundhay na hone dein aur kis tarah zulm kadah duniya ko noor-e-Ilahi se na jagmagane dein? Ab unhein jawab milta hai ke Quran ki sacchi haqaiq pe mabni aur sacchi khabrein Allah ki di hui hain jo Alim-ul-Ghaib hai, jis se ek zarra bhi posheeda nahin. Is mein mazi ke bayan sabhi sach hain. Jo aindah ki khabar is mein hai woh bhi sach hai. Allah ke samne ho chuki hui aur hone wali baat yaksaan hai. Woh ghaib ko bhi isi tarah jaanta hai jis tarah zahir ko. Is ke baad apni shan-e-ghaffariyat ko aur shan-e-raham-o-karam ko bayan farmaya taake bad log bhi is se mayoos na hon kuch bhi kiya ho. Ab bhi is ki taraf jhuk jayen. Tauba karein. Apne kiye par pachtayen. Nadam hon. Aur Rabb ki raza chahein. Rahmat-e-Rahim ke qurban jaiye ke aise sarkash-o-dushman, Allah-o-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par bohtan baaz, is qadar eizayein dene wale logon ko bhi apni aam rahmat ki dawat deta hai aur apne karam ki taraf unhein bulata hai.

Woh Allah ko bura kahein, woh Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko bura kahein, woh Kalam-e-Allah par baatein banayein aur Allah Ta'ala unhein apni rahmat ki taraf rahnumai kare, apne fazl-o-karam ki taraf dawat de. Islam aur hidayat un par pesh kare, apni bhali baatein unko sujhaye aur samjhaye. Chunancha aur aayat mein Isaiyon ki taslees parasti ka zikr kar ke unki saza ka bayan karte hue farmaya aayat (Afala yatoobuna ilallahi wa yastaghfirunahu, wallahu Ghafoorur Raheem) (Surah (Al-Ma'idah: 74). Yeh log kyun Allah se tauba nahin karte? Aur kyun uski taraf jhuk kar us se apne gunahon ki maafi talab nahin karte? Woh toh bada hi bakhshne wala aur bahut hi meharban hai. Mominon ko satane aur unhein fitne mein dalne walon ka zikr kar ke Surah Al-Buruj mein farmaya ki agar aise log bhi tauba kar lein, apne bure kamon se hat jayein, baaz aayein toh main bhi un par se apne azab hata lunga aur rahmatoon se nawaz dunga. Imam Hasan Basri (R.H) ne kaise maze ki baat bayan farmayi hai. Aap farmate hain Allah ke rahm-o-karam ko dekho, yeh log uske nek chaheete bandon ko satayein, maarein, qatl karein aur woh unhein tauba ki taraf aur apne rahm-o-karam ki taraf bulaye! Fasubhanahu ma a'zama sha'nah.)

Yeh jhoot bhi woh hai jis mein kisi ko shak na ho sake is liye ke sirf Ahl-e-Makkah hi nahin balkay duniya jaanti hai ke hamare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ummi thay na likhna jaante thay na parhna. Chalees saal ki nabuwwat se pehle ki zindagi aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki inhi logon mein guzar rahi thi aur woh is tarah ke itni muddat mein ek waqia bhi aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zindagi ka ya ek lamha bhi aisa na tha jis par ungli utha sake. Ek ek wasf aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka woh tha jis par zamana sheeda tha jis par Ahl-e-Makkah rashk karte thay. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aam maqbooliyat aur mehboobiyat buland ikhlaqi aur khush muamlagi itni barhi hui thi ke har ek dil mein aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke liye jagah thi. Aam zabanen aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Amin ke pyare khitab se pukarti thin. Duniya aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke qadmon talay ankhein bichati thi. Kaun sa dil tha jo Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka ghar na ho? Kaun si ankh thi jis mein Ahmad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki izzat na ho? Kaun sa majma tha jis ka zikr-e-khair na ho? Kaun woh shakhs tha jo aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki buzurgi, sadaqat, amanat, neki aur bhalai ka qail na ho? Phir jab ke Allah ki buland tareen izzat se aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) muazzaz kiye gaye, asmani wahi ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) amin banaye gaye, toh sirf baap dadon ki raush ko pamal hote hue dekh kar yeh bewaqoof be-painday lotay ki tarah lurhak gaye, thali ke baingan ki tarah idhar se udhar ho gaye, lagay baatein banane, aur aib joi karne. Lekin jhoot ke paon kahan? Kabhi aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko shair kehte, kabhi sahir, kabhi majnoon aur kabhi kazzab. Hairan thay ke kya kahein aur kis tarah apni jahilana raush ko baqi rakhein aur apne maboodan-e-batil ke jhanday oundhay na hone dein aur kis tarah zulm kadah duniya ko noor-e-Ilahi se na jagmagane dein? Ab unhein jawab milta hai ke Quran ki sacchi haqaiq pe mabni aur sacchi khabrein Allah ki di hui hain jo Alim-ul-Ghaib hai, jis se ek zarra bhi posheeda nahin. Is mein mazi ke bayan sabhi sach hain. Jo aindah ki khabar is mein hai woh bhi sach hai. Allah ke samne ho chuki hui aur hone wali baat yaksaan hai. Woh ghaib ko bhi isi tarah jaanta hai jis tarah zahir ko. Is ke baad apni shan-e-ghaffariyat ko aur shan-e-raham-o-karam ko bayan farmaya taake bad log bhi is se mayoos na hon kuch bhi kiya ho. Ab bhi is ki taraf jhuk jayen. Tauba karein. Apne kiye par pachtayen. Nadam hon. Aur Rabb ki raza chahein. Rahmat-e-Rahim ke qurban jaiye ke aise sarkash-o-dushman, Allah-o-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par bohtan baaz, is qadar eizayein dene wale logon ko bhi apni aam rahmat ki dawat deta hai aur apne karam ki taraf unhein bulata hai.

Woh Allah ko bura kahein, woh Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko bura kahein, woh Kalam-e-Allah par baatein banayein aur Allah Ta'ala unhein apni rahmat ki taraf rahnumai kare, apne fazl-o-karam ki taraf dawat de. Islam aur hidayat un par pesh kare, apni bhali baatein unko sujhaye aur samjhaye. Chunancha aur aayat mein Isaiyon ki taslees parasti ka zikr kar ke unki saza ka bayan karte hue farmaya aayat (Afala yatoobuna ilallahi wa yastaghfirunahu, wallahu Ghafoorur Raheem) (Surah (Al-Ma'idah: 74). Yeh log kyun Allah se tauba nahin karte? Aur kyun uski taraf jhuk kar us se apne gunahon ki maafi talab nahin karte? Woh toh bada hi bakhshne wala aur bahut hi meharban hai. Mominon ko satane aur unhein fitne mein dalne walon ka zikr kar ke Surah Al-Buruj mein farmaya ki agar aise log bhi tauba kar lein, apne bure kamon se hat jayein, baaz aayein toh main bhi un par se apne azab hata lunga aur rahmatoon se nawaz dunga. Imam Hasan Basri (R.H) ne kaise maze ki baat bayan farmayi hai. Aap farmate hain Allah ke rahm-o-karam ko dekho, yeh log uske nek chaheete bandon ko satayein, maarein, qatl karein aur woh unhein tauba ki taraf aur apne rahm-o-karam ki taraf bulaye! Fasubhanahu ma a'zama sha'nah.)

Mushrikeen ki hamaqatein is hamaqat ko mulahiza farmaye ke Rasool ki risalat ke inkar ki wajah yeh bayan karte hain ke yeh khane peene ka mohtaj kyun hai? Aur bazaron mein tijarat aur len-den ke liye aata jata kyun hai? Is ke sath hi koi farishta kyun nahin utara gaya? Ke woh is ke da'we ki tasdeeq karta aur logon ko is ke deen ki taraf bulata aur azab-e-Ilahi se aagah karta. Firaun ne bhi yahi kaha tha ke ayat (FALAWLA ULQIYA ALAIHI ASWIRATUM MIN ZAHABIN AW JAA'A MA'AHUL MALAA'IKATU MUQTARINEEN 53) (Az-Zukhruf: 53), is par sone ke kangan kyun nahin dale gaye? Ya is ki madad ke liye aasman se farishte kyun nahin utare gaye. Chunke dil in tamam kafiron ke yaksan hain. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane ke kuffar ne bhi kaha ke achha yeh nahin to ise koi khazana hi de diya jata ke yeh khud ba-aaram apni zindagi basar karta aur dusron ko bhi aasan hai lekin sardast in sab cheezon ke na dene mein bhi hikmat hai. Yeh zalim musalmanon ko bhi behkate hain aur kehte hain ke tum ek aise shakhs ke peeche lag liye ho jis par kisi ne jadu kar diya hai. Dekho to sahi ke kaisi bebunyad baatein banate hain, kisi ek baat par jam hi nahin sakte, idhar udhar karwatein le rahe hain kabhi jadugar keh diya to kabhi jadu kiya hua bata diya, kabhi sher keh diya kabhi jin ka sikhaya hua keh diya, kabhi kazzab kaha kabhi majnoon. Halankeh yeh sab baatein mehez ghalat hain aur in ka ghalat hona is se bhi wazeh hai ke khud in mein tazad hai kisi ek baat par khud in mushrikeen ka etimad nahin. Ghurte hain phir chhodte hain phir ghurte hain phir badalte hain kisi theek baat par jamte hi nahin. Jidhar mutawajjeh hote hain raah bhoolte aur thokar khate hain. Haq to ek hota hai is mein tazad aur ta'aruz nahin ho sakta. Namumkin hai ke yeh log in bhool bhulaiyon se nikal sakein. Beshak agar Rabb chahe to jo yeh kafir kehte hain is se behtar apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko duniya mein hi de de woh badi barkaton wala hai. Patthar se bane hue ghar ko Arab qasr kehte hain khwah woh bada ho ya chhota ho. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se to janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ki janib se farmaya aur jawab diya ke agar aap chahein to zameen ke khazane aur yahan ki kunjiyaan aap ko de di jayein aur is qadar duniya ka malik bana kar diya jaye ke kisi aur ko itni mili na ho sath hi aakhirat ki aap ki tamam ne'matein joon ki toon barqarar hain lekin aap ne ise pasand na farmaya aur jawab diya ke nahin mere liye to sab kuch aakhirat hi mein jama ho. Phir farmata hai ke yeh jo kuch kehte hain yeh sirf takabbur, anad, zid aur hat ke tor par kehte hain yeh nahin ke in ka kaha hua ho jaye to yeh musalman ho jayenge. Is waqt phir aur kuch heela bahana tatol nikalenge. In ke dil mein to yeh khayal jama hua hai ke qayamat hone ki nahin. Aur aise logon ke liye hum ne bhi azab-e-aleem tayyar kar rakha hai jo in ke dil ki bardasht se bahar hai jo bhadkane aur sulgane wali jhulas dene wali tez aag ka hai.

Abhi toh Jahannam un se sau saal ke faasle par hogi jab un ki nazrein us par aur us ki nigahein un par padengi wahin Jahannam pech-o-taab khaye gi aur josh-o-kharosh se aawazein nikale ga. Jise yeh badnaseeb sun lenge aur un ke hosh-o-hawaas khata ho jayenge, hosh jaate rahenge, hathon ke tote ud jayenge, Jahannam un badkaron par daant pees rahi hogi ke abhi abhi maare josh ke phat pade gi. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs mera naam le kar mere zimme woh baat kahe jo main ne na kahi ho woh Jahannam ki dono aankhon ke darmiyan apna thikana bana le. Logon ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya Jahannam ki bhi aankhein hain? Aap ne farmaya haan kya tum ne Allah ke kalaam ki yeh aayat nahin suni aayat (Iza ra'athum mim-makanim ba'idin sami'u laha taghayyuzan wa zafira) (Al-Furqan: 12). Ek martaba Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud (R.A) Hazrat Rabi' waghera ko saath liye hue kahin ja rahe the raaste mein lohar ki dukan aayi aap wahan thehar gaye aur loha jo aag mein tapaya ja raha tha use dekhne lage Hazrat Rabi' ka toh bura haal ho gaya azab-e-Ilahi ka naqsha aankhon tale phir gaya. Qareeb tha ke behosh ho kar gir padein. Is ke baad aap Furat ke kinare gaye wahan aap ne tanoor ko dekha ke us ke beech mein aag sholay maar rahi hai. Besakhta aap ki zaban se yeh aayat nikal gayi use sunte hi Hazrat Rabi' behosh ho kar gir pade charpai par daal kar aap ko ghar pahunchaya gaya subah se le kar dopahar tak Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) un ke paas baithe rahe aur chara joi karte rahe lekin Hazrat Rabi' ko hosh na aaya. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke jab Jahannami ko Jahannam ki taraf ghaseeta jayega Jahannam cheekhe gi aur ek aisi jhar-jhari le gi ke kul ahl-e-mahshar khauf-zada ho jayenge. Aur riwayat mein hai ke ba'az logon ko jab dozakh ki taraf le chalenge dozakh simat jayegi. Allah Ta'ala Maalik-o-Rahman us se puche ga yeh kya baat hai? Woh jawab de gi ke Aye Allah yeh toh apni duaon mein tujh se Jahannam se panah manga karta tha, aaj bhi panah maang raha hai. Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga phir tum kya samajh rahe the? Yeh kahenge yahi ke teri rahmat hamein chupa le gi, tera karam hamare shamil-e-haal hoga, teri wasee rahmat hamein apne daaman mein le le gi. Allah Ta'ala un ki aarzoo bhi poori kare ga aur hukm de ga ke mere in bandon ko bhi chhod do. Kuch aur log ghaseette hue aayenge unhein dekhte hi Jahannam un ki taraf shor machati hui badhe gi aur is tarah jhar-jhari le gi ke tamam majma-e-mahshar khauf-zada ho jayega. Hazrat Ubaid bin Umair farmate hain ke jab Jahannam maare gusse ke thartharay gi aur shor-o-ghul aur cheekh pukar aur josh-o-kharosh kare gi us waqt tamam muqarrab farishtey aur zi-rutba Anbiya (A.S) kaanpne lagenge yahan tak Khaleelullah Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) bhi apne ghutnon ke bal gir padenge aur kehne lagenge Aye Allah main aaj tujh se sirf apni jaan ka bachao chahta hoon aur kuch nahin mangta.

Yeh log jahannam ke aise tang-o-tareek makaan mein thons diye jayenge jaise bhala kisi suraakh mein aur riwayat mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is aayat ki baabat sawaal hona aur aap ka yeh farmana marwi hai ke jaise keel deewar mein bamushkil gaadi jaati hai is tarah in dozakhiyon ko thonsa jayega. Yeh us waqt khoob jakde hue honge, baal baal bandha hua hoga. Wahan woh maut ko, faut ko, halakat ko, hasrat ko pukarne lagenge. Un se kaha jayega ek maut ko kyun pukarte ho? Sadha hazarha mauton ko kyun nahin pukarte? Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai sab se pehle Iblees ko jahannami libaas pehnaya jayega, yeh ise apni peshani par rakh kar peeche se ghaseetta hua apni zurriyat ko peeche lagaye hue maut-o-halakat ko pukarta hua daudta phirega. Is ke saath hi is ki aulad bhi sab hasrat-o-afsos, maut-o-gharat ko pukaar rahi hogi. Us waqt un se yeh kaha jayega. Thuboor se muraad maut, wail, hasrat, khasaara, barbadi waghera hai. Jaise ke Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne Firaun se kaha tha aayat (وَاِنِّىْ لَاَظُنُّكَ يٰفِرْعَوْنُ مَثْبُوْرًا) (Surah (Al-Isra: 102) Firaun main to samajhta hoon ke tu mit kar barbaad ho kar hi rahega. Shair bhi lafz-e-thuboor ko halakat-o-barbadi ke ma'ani mein laye hain.)

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane ke kuffar ne bhi kaha ke achha yeh nahin to ise koi khazana hi de diya jata ke yeh khud ba-aaram apni zindagi basar karta aur dusron ko bhi aasan hai lekin sardast in sab cheezon ke na dene mein bhi hikmat hai. Yeh zalim musalmanon ko bhi behkate hain aur kehte hain ke tum ek aise shakhs ke peeche lag liye ho jis par kisi ne jadu kar diya hai. Dekho to sahi ke kaisi bebunyad baatein banate hain, kisi ek baat par jam hi nahin sakte, idhar udhar karwatein le rahe hain kabhi jadugar keh diya to kabhi jadu kiya hua bata diya, kabhi sher keh diya kabhi jin ka sikhaya hua keh diya, kabhi kazzab kaha kabhi majnoon. Halankeh yeh sab baatein mehez ghalat hain aur in ka ghalat hona is se bhi wazeh hai ke khud in mein tazad hai kisi ek baat par khud in mushrikeen ka etimad nahin. Ghurte hain phir chhodte hain phir ghurte hain phir badalte hain kisi theek baat par jamte hi nahin. Jidhar mutawajjeh hote hain raah bhoolte aur thokar khate hain. Haq to ek hota hai is mein tazad aur ta'aruz nahin ho sakta. Namumkin hai ke yeh log in bhool bhulaiyon se nikal sakein. Beshak agar Rabb chahe to jo yeh kafir kehte hain is se behtar apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko duniya mein hi de de woh badi barkaton wala hai. Patthar se bane hue ghar ko Arab qasr kehte hain khwah woh bada ho ya chhota ho. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se to janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ki janib se farmaya aur jawab diya ke agar aap chahein to zameen ke khazane aur yahan ki kunjiyaan aap ko de di jayein aur is qadar duniya ka malik bana kar diya jaye ke kisi aur ko itni mili na ho sath hi aakhirat ki aap ki tamam ne'matein joon ki toon barqarar hain lekin aap ne ise pasand na farmaya aur jawab diya ke nahin mere liye to sab kuch aakhirat hi mein jama ho. Phir farmata hai ke yeh jo kuch kehte hain yeh sirf takabbur, anad, zid aur hat ke tor par kehte hain yeh nahin ke in ka kaha hua ho jaye to yeh musalman ho jayenge. Is waqt phir aur kuch heela bahana tatol nikalenge. In ke dil mein to yeh khayal jama hua hai ke qayamat hone ki nahin. Aur aise logon ke liye hum ne bhi azab-e-aleem tayyar kar rakha hai jo in ke dil ki bardasht se bahar hai jo bhadkane aur sulgane wali jhulas dene wali tez aag ka hai.

Abhi toh Jahannam un se sau saal ke faasle par hogi jab un ki nazrein us par aur us ki nigahein un par padengi wahin Jahannam pech-o-taab khaye gi aur josh-o-kharosh se aawazein nikale ga. Jise yeh badnaseeb sun lenge aur un ke hosh-o-hawaas khata ho jayenge, hosh jaate rahenge, hathon ke tote ud jayenge, Jahannam un badkaron par daant pees rahi hogi ke abhi abhi maare josh ke phat pade gi. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs mera naam le kar mere zimme woh baat kahe jo main ne na kahi ho woh Jahannam ki dono aankhon ke darmiyan apna thikana bana le. Logon ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya Jahannam ki bhi aankhein hain? Aap ne farmaya haan kya tum ne Allah ke kalaam ki yeh aayat nahin suni aayat (Iza ra'athum mim-makanim ba'idin sami'u laha taghayyuzan wa zafira) (Al-Furqan: 12). Ek martaba Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud (R.A) Hazrat Rabi' waghera ko saath liye hue kahin ja rahe the raaste mein lohar ki dukan aayi aap wahan thehar gaye aur loha jo aag mein tapaya ja raha tha use dekhne lage Hazrat Rabi' ka toh bura haal ho gaya azab-e-Ilahi ka naqsha aankhon tale phir gaya. Qareeb tha ke behosh ho kar gir padein. Is ke baad aap Furat ke kinare gaye wahan aap ne tanoor ko dekha ke us ke beech mein aag sholay maar rahi hai. Besakhta aap ki zaban se yeh aayat nikal gayi use sunte hi Hazrat Rabi' behosh ho kar gir pade charpai par daal kar aap ko ghar pahunchaya gaya subah se le kar dopahar tak Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) un ke paas baithe rahe aur chara joi karte rahe lekin Hazrat Rabi' ko hosh na aaya. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke jab Jahannami ko Jahannam ki taraf ghaseeta jayega Jahannam cheekhe gi aur ek aisi jhar-jhari le gi ke kul ahl-e-mahshar khauf-zada ho jayenge. Aur riwayat mein hai ke ba'az logon ko jab dozakh ki taraf le chalenge dozakh simat jayegi. Allah Ta'ala Maalik-o-Rahman us se puche ga yeh kya baat hai? Woh jawab de gi ke Aye Allah yeh toh apni duaon mein tujh se Jahannam se panah manga karta tha, aaj bhi panah maang raha hai. Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga phir tum kya samajh rahe the? Yeh kahenge yahi ke teri rahmat hamein chupa le gi, tera karam hamare shamil-e-haal hoga, teri wasee rahmat hamein apne daaman mein le le gi. Allah Ta'ala un ki aarzoo bhi poori kare ga aur hukm de ga ke mere in bandon ko bhi chhod do. Kuch aur log ghaseette hue aayenge unhein dekhte hi Jahannam un ki taraf shor machati hui badhe gi aur is tarah jhar-jhari le gi ke tamam majma-e-mahshar khauf-zada ho jayega. Hazrat Ubaid bin Umair farmate hain ke jab Jahannam maare gusse ke thartharay gi aur shor-o-ghul aur cheekh pukar aur josh-o-kharosh kare gi us waqt tamam muqarrab farishtey aur zi-rutba Anbiya (A.S) kaanpne lagenge yahan tak Khaleelullah Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) bhi apne ghutnon ke bal gir padenge aur kehne lagenge Aye Allah main aaj tujh se sirf apni jaan ka bachao chahta hoon aur kuch nahin mangta.

Yeh log jahannam ke aise tang-o-tareek makaan mein thons diye jayenge jaise bhala kisi suraakh mein aur riwayat mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is aayat ki baabat sawaal hona aur aap ka yeh farmana marwi hai ke jaise keel deewar mein bamushkil gaadi jaati hai is tarah in dozakhiyon ko thonsa jayega. Yeh us waqt khoob jakde hue honge, baal baal bandha hua hoga. Wahan woh maut ko, faut ko, halakat ko, hasrat ko pukarne lagenge. Un se kaha jayega ek maut ko kyun pukarte ho? Sadha hazarha mauton ko kyun nahin pukarte? Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai sab se pehle Iblees ko jahannami libaas pehnaya jayega, yeh ise apni peshani par rakh kar peeche se ghaseetta hua apni zurriyat ko peeche lagaye hue maut-o-halakat ko pukarta hua daudta phirega. Is ke saath hi is ki aulad bhi sab hasrat-o-afsos, maut-o-gharat ko pukaar rahi hogi. Us waqt un se yeh kaha jayega. Thuboor se muraad maut, wail, hasrat, khasaara, barbadi waghera hai. Jaise ke Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne Firaun se kaha tha aayat (وَاِنِّىْ لَاَظُنُّكَ يٰفِرْعَوْنُ مَثْبُوْرًا) (Surah (Al-Isra: 102) Firaun main to samajhta hoon ke tu mit kar barbaad ho kar hi rahega. Shair bhi lafz-e-thuboor ko halakat-o-barbadi ke ma'ani mein laye hain.)

Yeh log jahannam ke aise tang-o-tareek makaan mein thons diye jayenge jaise bhala kisi suraakh mein aur riwayat mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is aayat ki baabat sawaal hona aur aap ka yeh farmana marwi hai ke jaise keel deewar mein bamushkil gaadi jaati hai is tarah in dozakhiyon ko thonsa jayega. Yeh us waqt khoob jakde hue honge, baal baal bandha hua hoga. Wahan woh maut ko, faut ko, halakat ko, hasrat ko pukarne lagenge. Un se kaha jayega ek maut ko kyun pukarte ho? Sadha hazarha mauton ko kyun nahin pukarte? Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai sab se pehle Iblees ko jahannami libaas pehnaya jayega, yeh ise apni peshani par rakh kar peeche se ghaseetta hua apni zurriyat ko peeche lagaye hue maut-o-halakat ko pukarta hua daudta phirega. Is ke saath hi is ki aulad bhi sab hasrat-o-afsos, maut-o-gharat ko pukaar rahi hogi. Us waqt un se yeh kaha jayega. Thuboor se muraad maut, wail, hasrat, khasaara, barbadi waghera hai. Jaise ke Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne Firaun se kaha tha aayat (وَاِنِّىْ لَاَظُنُّكَ يٰفِرْعَوْنُ مَثْبُوْرًا) (Surah (Al-Isra: 102) Firaun main to samajhta hoon ke tu mit kar barbaad ho kar hi rahega. Shair bhi lafz-e-thuboor ko halakat-o-barbadi ke ma'ani mein laye hain.)

Mushrikeen ki hamaqatein is hamaqat ko mulahiza farmaye ke Rasool ki risalat ke inkar ki wajah yeh bayan karte hain ke yeh khane peene ka mohtaj kyun hai? Aur bazaron mein tijarat aur len-den ke liye aata jata kyun hai? Is ke sath hi koi farishta kyun nahin utara gaya? Ke woh is ke da'we ki tasdeeq karta aur logon ko is ke deen ki taraf bulata aur azab-e-Ilahi se aagah karta. Firaun ne bhi yahi kaha tha ke ayat (FALAWLA ULQIYA ALAIHI ASWIRATUM MIN ZAHABIN AW JAA'A MA'AHUL MALAA'IKATU MUQTARINEEN 53) (Az-Zukhruf: 53), is par sone ke kangan kyun nahin dale gaye? Ya is ki madad ke liye aasman se farishte kyun nahin utare gaye. Chunke dil in tamam kafiron ke yaksan hain. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane ke kuffar ne bhi kaha ke achha yeh nahin to ise koi khazana hi de diya jata ke yeh khud ba-aaram apni zindagi basar karta aur dusron ko bhi aasan hai lekin sardast in sab cheezon ke na dene mein bhi hikmat hai. Yeh zalim musalmanon ko bhi behkate hain aur kehte hain ke tum ek aise shakhs ke peeche lag liye ho jis par kisi ne jadu kar diya hai. Dekho to sahi ke kaisi bebunyad baatein banate hain, kisi ek baat par jam hi nahin sakte, idhar udhar karwatein le rahe hain kabhi jadugar keh diya to kabhi jadu kiya hua bata diya, kabhi sher keh diya kabhi jin ka sikhaya hua keh diya, kabhi kazzab kaha kabhi majnoon. Halankeh yeh sab baatein mehez ghalat hain aur in ka ghalat hona is se bhi wazeh hai ke khud in mein tazad hai kisi ek baat par khud in mushrikeen ka etimad nahin. Ghurte hain phir chhodte hain phir ghurte hain phir badalte hain kisi theek baat par jamte hi nahin. Jidhar mutawajjeh hote hain raah bhoolte aur thokar khate hain. Haq to ek hota hai is mein tazad aur ta'aruz nahin ho sakta. Namumkin hai ke yeh log in bhool bhulaiyon se nikal sakein. Beshak agar Rabb chahe to jo yeh kafir kehte hain is se behtar apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko duniya mein hi de de woh badi barkaton wala hai. Patthar se bane hue ghar ko Arab qasr kehte hain khwah woh bada ho ya chhota ho. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se to janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ki janib se farmaya aur jawab diya ke agar aap chahein to zameen ke khazane aur yahan ki kunjiyaan aap ko de di jayein aur is qadar duniya ka malik bana kar diya jaye ke kisi aur ko itni mili na ho sath hi aakhirat ki aap ki tamam ne'matein joon ki toon barqarar hain lekin aap ne ise pasand na farmaya aur jawab diya ke nahin mere liye to sab kuch aakhirat hi mein jama ho. Phir farmata hai ke yeh jo kuch kehte hain yeh sirf takabbur, anad, zid aur hat ke tor par kehte hain yeh nahin ke in ka kaha hua ho jaye to yeh musalman ho jayenge. Is waqt phir aur kuch heela bahana tatol nikalenge. In ke dil mein to yeh khayal jama hua hai ke qayamat hone ki nahin. Aur aise logon ke liye hum ne bhi azab-e-aleem tayyar kar rakha hai jo in ke dil ki bardasht se bahar hai jo bhadkane aur sulgane wali jhulas dene wali tez aag ka hai.

Abhi toh Jahannam un se sau saal ke faasle par hogi jab un ki nazrein us par aur us ki nigahein un par padengi wahin Jahannam pech-o-taab khaye gi aur josh-o-kharosh se aawazein nikale ga. Jise yeh badnaseeb sun lenge aur un ke hosh-o-hawaas khata ho jayenge, hosh jaate rahenge, hathon ke tote ud jayenge, Jahannam un badkaron par daant pees rahi hogi ke abhi abhi maare josh ke phat pade gi. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs mera naam le kar mere zimme woh baat kahe jo main ne na kahi ho woh Jahannam ki dono aankhon ke darmiyan apna thikana bana le. Logon ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya Jahannam ki bhi aankhein hain? Aap ne farmaya haan kya tum ne Allah ke kalaam ki yeh aayat nahin suni aayat (Iza ra'athum mim-makanim ba'idin sami'u laha taghayyuzan wa zafira) (Al-Furqan: 12). Ek martaba Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud (R.A) Hazrat Rabi' waghera ko saath liye hue kahin ja rahe the raaste mein lohar ki dukan aayi aap wahan thehar gaye aur loha jo aag mein tapaya ja raha tha use dekhne lage Hazrat Rabi' ka toh bura haal ho gaya azab-e-Ilahi ka naqsha aankhon tale phir gaya. Qareeb tha ke behosh ho kar gir padein. Is ke baad aap Furat ke kinare gaye wahan aap ne tanoor ko dekha ke us ke beech mein aag sholay maar rahi hai. Besakhta aap ki zaban se yeh aayat nikal gayi use sunte hi Hazrat Rabi' behosh ho kar gir pade charpai par daal kar aap ko ghar pahunchaya gaya subah se le kar dopahar tak Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) un ke paas baithe rahe aur chara joi karte rahe lekin Hazrat Rabi' ko hosh na aaya. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke jab Jahannami ko Jahannam ki taraf ghaseeta jayega Jahannam cheekhe gi aur ek aisi jhar-jhari le gi ke kul ahl-e-mahshar khauf-zada ho jayenge. Aur riwayat mein hai ke ba'az logon ko jab dozakh ki taraf le chalenge dozakh simat jayegi. Allah Ta'ala Maalik-o-Rahman us se puche ga yeh kya baat hai? Woh jawab de gi ke Aye Allah yeh toh apni duaon mein tujh se Jahannam se panah manga karta tha, aaj bhi panah maang raha hai. Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga phir tum kya samajh rahe the? Yeh kahenge yahi ke teri rahmat hamein chupa le gi, tera karam hamare shamil-e-haal hoga, teri wasee rahmat hamein apne daaman mein le le gi. Allah Ta'ala un ki aarzoo bhi poori kare ga aur hukm de ga ke mere in bandon ko bhi chhod do. Kuch aur log ghaseette hue aayenge unhein dekhte hi Jahannam un ki taraf shor machati hui badhe gi aur is tarah jhar-jhari le gi ke tamam majma-e-mahshar khauf-zada ho jayega. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs mera naam le kar mere zimme woh baat kahe jo main ne na kahi ho woh Jahannam ki dono aankhon ke darmiyan apna thikana bana le. Logon ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya Jahannam ki bhi aankhein hain? Aap ne farmaya haan kya tum ne Allah ke kalaam ki yeh aayat nahin suni aayat (Iza ra'athum mim-makanim ba'idin sami'u laha taghayyuzan wa zafira) (Al-Furqan: 12). Ek martaba Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud (R.A) Hazrat Rabi' waghera ko saath liye hue kahin ja rahe the raaste mein lohar ki dukan aayi aap wahan thehar gaye aur loha jo aag mein tapaya ja raha tha use dekhne lage Hazrat Rabi' ka toh bura haal ho gaya azab-e-Ilahi ka naqsha aankhon tale phir gaya. Qareeb tha ke behosh ho kar gir padein. Is ke baad aap Furat ke kinare gaye wahan aap ne tanoor ko dekha ke us ke beech mein aag sholay maar rahi hai. Besakhta aap ki zaban se yeh aayat nikal gayi use sunte hi Hazrat Rabi' behosh ho kar gir pade charpai par daal kar aap ko ghar pahunchaya gaya subah se le kar dopahar tak Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) un ke paas baithe rahe aur chara joi karte rahe lekin Hazrat Rabi' ko hosh na aaya. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke jab Jahannami ko Jahannam ki taraf ghaseeta jayega Jahannam cheekhe gi aur ek aisi jhar-jhari le gi ke kul ahl-e-mahshar khauf-zada ho jayenge. Aur riwayat mein hai ke ba'az logon ko jab dozakh ki taraf le chalenge dozakh simat jayegi. Allah Ta'ala Maalik-o-Rahman us se puche ga yeh kya baat hai? Woh jawab de gi ke Aye Allah yeh toh apni duaon mein tujh se Jahannam se panah manga karta tha, aaj bhi panah maang raha hai. Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga phir tum kya samajh rahe the? Yeh kahenge yahi ke teri rahmat hamein chupa le gi, tera karam hamare shamil-e-haal hoga, teri wasee rahmat hamein apne daaman mein le le gi. Allah Ta'ala un ki aarzoo bhi poori kare ga aur hukm de ga ke mere in bandon ko bhi chhod do. Kuch aur log ghaseette hue aayenge unhein dekhte hi Jahannam un ki taraf shor machati hui badhe gi aur is tarah jhar-jhari le gi ke tamam majma-e-mahshar khauf-zada ho jayega. Hazrat Ubaid bin Umair farmate hain ke jab Jahannam maare gusse ke thartharay gi aur shor-o-ghul aur cheekh pukar aur josh-o-kharosh kare gi us waqt tamam muqarrab farishtey aur zi-rutba Anbiya (A.S) kaanpne lagenge yahan tak Khaleelullah Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) bhi apne ghutnon ke bal gir padenge aur kehne lagenge Aye Allah main aaj tujh se sirf apni jaan ka bachao chahta hoon aur kuch nahin mangta.

Yeh log jahannam ke aise tang-o-tareek makaan mein thons diye jayenge jaise bhala kisi suraakh mein aur riwayat mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is aayat ki baabat sawaal hona aur aap ka yeh farmana marwi hai ke jaise keel deewar mein bamushkil gaadi jaati hai is tarah in dozakhiyon ko thonsa jayega. Yeh us waqt khoob jakde hue honge, baal baal bandha hua hoga. Wahan woh maut ko, faut ko, halakat ko, hasrat ko pukarne lagenge. Un se kaha jayega ek maut ko kyun pukarte ho? Sadha hazarha mauton ko kyun nahin pukarte? Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai sab se pehle Iblees ko jahannami libaas pehnaya jayega, yeh ise apni peshani par rakh kar peeche se ghaseetta hua apni zurriyat ko peeche lagaye hue maut-o-halakat ko pukarta hua daudta phirega. Is ke saath hi is ki aulad bhi sab hasrat-o-afsos, maut-o-gharat ko pukaar rahi hogi. Us waqt un se yeh kaha jayega. Thuboor se muraad maut, wail, hasrat, khasaara, barbadi waghera hai. Jaise ke Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne Firaun se kaha tha aayat (وَاِنِّىْ لَاَظُنُّكَ يٰفِرْعَوْنُ مَثْبُوْرًا) (Surah (Al-Isra: 102) Firaun main to samajhta hoon ke tu mit kar barbaad ho kar hi rahega. Shair bhi lafz-e-thuboor ko halakat-o-barbadi ke ma'ani mein laye hain.)

Abadi lazzatein aur musarratein upar bayan farmaya un badkaron ka jo zillat-o-khwari ke sath oundhay munh jahannam ki taraf ghasitay jayenge aur sar ke bal wahan phenk diye jayenge. Bandhay bandhaye honge aur tang-o-tareek jagah honge, na chhoot sakein na harkat kar sakein, na bhag sakein na nikal sakein. Phir farmata hai batlao yeh achhay hain ya woh? Jo duniya mein gunahon se bachtay rahe Allah ka dar dil mein rakhte rahe aur aaj us ke badlay apne asli thikanay pahunch gaye yani jannat mein jahan man-mani ne'matein abadi lazzatein daimi musarratein un ke liye majood hain umda khanay, achhay bichhonay, behtareen sawariyan, pur-takalluf libas behtar behtar makanat, bani sanwari pakeeza hoorein, rahat-afza manzar, un ke liye muhayya hain jahan tak kisi ki nigahain to kahan khayalat bhi nahin pahunch sakte. Na un rahaton ke bayanat kisi kaan mein pahunche. Phir un ke kam hojane, kharab hojane, toot jane, khatam hojane, ka bhi koi khatra nahin aur na hi wahan se nikale jayen na woh ne'matein kam hon. Lazawal, behtareen zindagi, abadi rahmat, dawami ki daulat unhein mil gayi aur un ki ho gayi. Yeh Rabb ka ehsan-o-in'aam hai jo un par hua aur jis ke yeh mustahiq thay. Rabb ka wada hai jo us ne apne zimmay kar liya hai jo ho kar rehne wala hai jis ka adam-e-ifa namumkin hai, jis ka ghalat hona muhaal hai. Us se us ke waday ke poora karne ka sawal karo, us se jannat talab karo, usay us ka wada yaad dilao. Yeh bhi us ka fazl hai ke us ke farishtay us se duayein karte rehte hain ke Rabb-ul-Aalameen momin bandon se jo tera wada hai usay poora kar aur unhein Jannat-e-Adan mein le ja. Qayamat ke din momin kahenge ke ae hamare Parwardigar tere waday ko samne rakh kar hum amal karte rahe aaj tu apna wada poora kar. Yahan pehle dozakhiyon ka zikr kar ke phir sawal ke baad jannatiyon ka zikr hua. Surah Saffat mein jannatiyon ka zikr kar ke phir sawal ke baad dozakhiyon ka zikr hua ke kya yahi behtar hai ya Zaqqoom ka darakht? Jisay hum ne zalimon ke liye fitna bana rakha hai jo jahannam ki jad se nikalta hai jis ke phal aisay badnuma hain jaise saanp ke phan dozakhi usay khayenge aur isi se pet bharna padega phir kholta hua garam pani peep waghera mila jula peene ko diya jayega phir un ka thikana jahannam hoga. Unhon ne apne baap dadon ko gumrah paya aur betahasha un ke peeche lapakna shuru kar diya.

Isa A.S se sawalat bayan ho raha hai ke mushrik jin jin ki ibadatein Allah ke siwa karte rahe qayamat ke din unhein unke samne un par azab ke alawa zabani sarzanish bhi ki jayegi taake woh nadim hon. Hazrat Isa A.S, Hazrat Uzair A.S aur farishtay jin jin ki ibadat hui thi sab majood honge aur unke aabid bhi. Sab isi majmay mein majood honge. Us waqt Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala un maboodon se daryaft farmayega ke kya tumne mere in bandon se apni ibadat karne ko kaha tha? Ya yeh az-khud aisa karne lage? Chunancha aur aayat mein hai ke Hazrat Isa A.S se bhi yahi sawal hoga. Jiska woh jawab denge ke main ne unhein hargiz is baat ki taleem nahin di yeh jaisa ke tujh par khoob roshan hai main ne toh unhein wahi kaha tha jo tu ne mujh se kaha tha ke ibadat ke laiq faqat Allah hi hai. Yeh sab mabood jo Allah ke siwa thay aur Allah ke sachay banday thay aur shirk se bezar thay jawab denge ke kisi makhlooq ko hum ko ya unko yeh laiq hi na tha ke tere siwa kisi aur ki ibadat karein hum ne hargiz unhein is shirk ki taleem nahin di. Khud hi unhon ne apni khushi se dusron ki pooja shuru kardi thi hum un se aur unki ibadaton se bezar hain. Hum unke is shirk se bari-uz-zimma hain. Hum toh khud tere aabid hain. Phir kaise mumkin tha ke maboodiyat ke mansab par aajate? Yeh toh hamare laiq hi na tha, teri zaat is se bahut pak aur bartar hai ke koi tera shareek ho. Chunancha aur aayat mein sirf farishton se is sawal jawab ka hona bhi bayan hua hai. Natakhizu ki dusri qira'at nattakhiza bhi hai yani yeh kisi tarah nahin ho sakta tha, na yeh hamare laiq tha ke log hamein poojne lagein aur teri ibadat chhod dein. Kyunke hum toh khud tere banday hain, tere dar ke bhikari hain. Matlab donon suraton mein qareeb qareeb ek hi hai. Unke behakne ki wajah hamari samajh mein toh yeh aati hai ke unhein umrein milein, hi bahut khane peene ko milta raha bad-masti mein badhte gaye yahan tak ke jo nasihat rasoolon ki ma'rifat pahunchi thi use bhula diya. Teri ibadat se aur sachi tauheed se hat gaye. Yeh log thay yeh be-khabar, halakat ke garhay mein gir pade. Tabah-o-barbad hogaye. Booran se matlab halak wale hi hain. Jaise Ibn-e-Ziba'ri ne apne sher mein is lafz ko is ma'ni mein bandha hai. Ab Allah Ta'ala un mushrikon se farmayega lo ab toh tumhare yeh mabood khud tumhein jhutla rahe hain tum toh unhein apna samajh kar is khayal se ke yeh tumhein Allah ke muqarrab banadenge unki pooja paat karte rahe, aaj yeh tum se koson door bhag rahe hain tum se yaksu ho rahe hain aur bezari zahir kar rahe hain. Jaise irshad hai aayat (Wa man adallu mimman yad'u min doonillahi mal la yastajeebu lahu ila yaumil qiyamati wa hum 'an du'a'ihim ghafiloon) (46).

(Al-Ahqaf: 5), yani is se zyada gumrah kaun hai jo Allah ke siwa aison ko pukarta hai jo Qayamat tak uski chahat poori na kar sakein, balkeh woh to unki dua se mehez ghafil hain aur mehshar wale din yeh sab un sab ke dushman ho jayenge aur unki ibadaton ke saaf munkir ho jayenge. Pas Qayamat ke din yeh mushrikeen na to apni janon se azab-e-Allah hata sakenge aur na apni madad kar sakenge, na kisi ko apna madadgar payenge. Tum mein se jo bhi Allah Wahid ke sath shirk kare, hum use zabardast aur nihayat sakht azab karenge.

Kafir jo is baat par aitraz karte the ke Nabi ko khane peene aur tijarat byopar se kya matlab? Is ka jawab ho raha hai ke agle sab paighambar bhi insani zarooratein bhi rakhte the khana peena un ke sath bhi laga hua tha. Byopar, tijarat aur kasb-e-ma'ash woh bhi kiya karte the yeh cheezein nabuwwat ke khilaf nahin. Haan Allah Ta'ala Azza-wa-Jal apni inayat-e-khas se unhein woh pakeeza ausaf, nek khasail, umda aqwal, mukhtar af'aal, zahir daleelein, aala mo'jize deta hai ke har aql-e-saleem wala har dana beena majboor hojata hai ke un ki nabuwwat ko tasleem kar le aur un ki sachai ko maan le. Isi aayat jaisi aur aayat (Wama arsalna min qablika illa rijalan noohi ilaihim fas'alu ahlaz zikri in kuntum la ta'lamoon) (16-An-Nahl: 43) hai. Ya'ni tujh se pehle bhi jitne Nabi aaye sab shehron mein rehne wale insan hi the. Aur aayat mein hai (Wama ja'alnahum jasadan la ya'kulunat ta'ama wama kanu khalideen) (21-Al-Anbiya: 8), hum ne unhein aise juthay nahin bana rakhe the ke khane peene se woh azad hon. Hum to tum mein se ek ek ki aazmaish ek ek se kar liya karte hain taake farmanbardar aur nafarman zahir ho jayen. Sabir aur ghair sabir maloom ho jayen. Tera Rab dana-o-beena hai khoob janta hai ke mustahiq-e-nabuwwat kaun hai? Jaise farmaya aayat (Allahu a'lamu haithu yaj'alu risalatahu sayuseebullazeena ajramu sagharun indallahi wa azabun shadeedun bima kanu yamkuroon) (6-Al-An'am: 124) mansab-e-risalat ki ahliyat kis mein hai? Ise Allah hi bakhoobi janta hai. Isi ko is ka ilm hai ke mustahiq-e-hidayat kaun hain? Aur kaun nahin? Faislon ka din Qayamat ke din jo holnak umoor honge un mein se ek aasman ka phat jana aur noorani abr ka namudar hona bhi hai jis ki roshni se aankhein chaka-chond ho jayengi phir farishtay utrein ge aur maidan-e-mahshar mein tamam insanon ko gher len ge. Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala apne bandon mein faislay ke liye tashreef laye ga. Jaise farman hai aayat (هَلْ يَنْظُرُوْنَ اِلَّآ اَنْ تَاْتِيَهُمُ الْمَلٰۗىِٕكَةُ اَوْ يَاْتِيَ اَمْرُ رَبِّكَ) (Surah (An-Nahl: 33) yani ke inhe is baat ka intezar hai ke Allah Ta'ala aur us ke farishtay badalon mein aayen. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala apni tamam makhlooq ko sab insanon aur kul jinnat ko ek maidan mein jama kare ga. Tamam janwar, chopaye, darinday, parinday aur kul makhlooq wahan hogi phir aasman-e-awwal phate ga aur us ke farishtay utrein ge jo tamam makhlooq ko do taraf se gher len ge aur woh ginti mein bohat zyada honge phir dusra aasman phate ga us ke farishtay bhi aayen ge jo zameen ki aur aasman-e-awwal ki tamam makhlooq ki ginti se bhi zyada honge. Phir teesra aasman shaq hoga us ke farishtay bhi dono aasmanon ke farishtay mil kar zameen ki makhlooq se bhi zyada honge sab ko gher kar kharay ho jayen ge. Phir isi tarah chotha, panchwan, phir chatha, phir saatwan, phir hamara Rab abr ke saye mein tashreef laye ga us ke gird-o-pesh buzurg-tar pak farishtay honge jo saaton aasmanon aur saaton zameeno ki kul makhlooq se bhi zyada honge un par seengon jaise nishan honge, woh Allah ke Arsh ke neeche Allah ki tasbeeh-o-tahleel-o-taqaddus bayan karen ge, un ke talway se le kar takhnay tak ka fasla panch sau saal ka rasta hoga aur takhnay se ghutnay tak ka bhi utna hi. Aur ghutnay se naaf tak ka bhi utna hi fasla hoga. Aur naaf se gardan ka fasla bhi utna hoga aur gardan se kaan ki lau tak bhi utna fasla hoga aur us ke oopar se sar tak ka bhi utna fasla hoga. Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka farman hai ke Qayamat ka naam Yaum-ut-Talaq isi liye hai ke is mein zameen aur aasman walay milen ge inhe dekh pehle to mahshar walay samajh len ge ke hamara Allah aaya lekin farishtay samjha den ge ke woh aanay wala hai abhi tak nazil nahin hua. Phir jab ke saaton aasmanon ke farishtay aa jayen ge Allah Ta'ala apne Arsh par tashreef laye ga jise aath farishtay uthaye hon jin ke takhnay se ghutnay tak sattar saal ka rasta hai aur raan aur mondhay ke darmiyan bhi sattar saal ka rasta hai har farishta dusre se alaihda aur judagana hai har ek ki thodi seenay se lagi hui hai aur zaban par Subhan-al-Malik-il-Quddus ka wazifa hai. Un ke saron par ek phaili hui hai jaise surkh shafaq us ke oopar Arsh hoga. Is mein rawi Ali bin Zaid bin Jud'an hain jo za'eef hain aur bhi is hadith mein bohat si khamiyan hain. Soor ki mashhoor hadith mein bhi isi ke qareeb qareeb marwi hai. Wallahu A'lam aur aayat mein hai ke us din ho parne wali ho pare gi aur aasman phat kar rooi ki tarah ho jaye ga.

Aur us ke kinaron par farishtay honge aur us din tere Rab ka Arsh aath farishtay liye honge. Shahr bin Haushab kehte hain in mein se chaar ki tasbeeh toh yeh hogi: (Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika lakal hamdu 'ala hilmika ba'da 'ilmika) Aye Allah tu paak hai, tu qabil-e-sataish-o-tareef hai, bawajood ilm ke phir bhi bardbari baratna tera wasf hai jis par hum teri tareef bayan karte hain. Aur chaar ki tasbeeh yeh hogi: (Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika lakal hamdu 'ala 'afwika ba'da qudratika) Aye Allah tu paak hai aur apni tareefon ke sath hai, tere hi liye sab tareef hai ke tu bawajood qudrat ke maaf farmata rehta hai. Abu Bakr bin Abdullah (Rahimahullah) kehte hain ke Arsh ko utarta dekh kar ahl-e-mahshar ki aankhein phat jayengi, jism kaanp uthenge, dil laraz jayenge. Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) farmate hain ke jis waqt Allah Azza-wa-Jal makhlooq ki taraf utrega toh darmiyan mein sattar hazaar parday honge, ba'z noor ke ba'z zulmat ke. Is zulmat mein se ek aisi aawaz niklegi jis se dil paash-paash ho jayenge, shayad un ki yeh riwayat inhi do theelon mein se li hui hogi, Wallahu A'lam. Us din sirf Allah hi ki badshahat hogi jaise farman hai: (Limanil mulkul yaum, lillahil wahidil qahhar) (Surah (Al-Ghafir: 16) Aaj mulk kis ke liye hai? Sirf Allah Ghalib-o-Qahhar ke liye. Sahih hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala aasmanon ko apne dahine haath se lapet lega aur zameenon ko apne dusre haath mein le lega phir farmayega main maalik hoon, main faisla karne wala hoon, zameen ke badshah kahan hain? Takabbur karne wale kahan hain? Woh din kuffar par bada bhari pada hoga. Isi ka bayan aur jagah bhi hai ke kafiron par woh din garan guzrega. Haan mominon ko us din mutlaq ghabrahat ya pareshani na hogi. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha gaya Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) pachaas hazaar saal ka din toh bahut hi daraz hoga. Aap ne farmaya us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai ke momin par toh woh ek waqt ki farz namaz se bhi halka aur aasaan hoga. Paighambar (A.S) ke tareeqay aur aap aur aap ke laye hue khulay haq se hat kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki raah ke siwa dusri raahon pe chalne wale us din bade hi nadim honge aur hasrat-o-afsos ke sath apne haath chabayenge. Go is ka nuzool Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait ke bare mein ho ya kisi aur ke bare mein lekin hukm ke aitbar se yeh har aise zalim ko shamil hai. Jaise farman hai: (Yauma tuqallabu wujuhuhum fin-nari yaquluna ya laitana ata'nallaha wa ata'nar-rasula) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 66) poori do aayaton tak. Pas har zalim Qayamat ke din pachtayega, apne hathon ko chabayega aur aah-o-zari karke kahega kaash ke main ne Nabi ki raah apnayi hoti. Kaash ke main ne falan ki aqeedat-mandi na ki hoti, jis ne mujhe raah-e-haq se gum kar diya. Umayyah bin Khalaf ka aur us ke bhai Ubay bin Khalaf ka bhi yahi haal hoga aur un ke siwa aur bhi aise logon ka yeh haal hoga. Kahega ke us ne mujhe zikr yani Quran se begana kar diya halankeh woh mujh tak pahunch chuka tha.

Allah Ta'ala farmata hai shaitan insaan ko ruswa karne wala hai, woh usey na-haq ki taraf bulata hai aur haq se hata deta hai.)))

Allah Ta'ala farmata hai shaitan insaan ko ruswa karne wala hai, woh usey na-haq ki taraf bulata hai aur haq se hata deta hai.)))

Aur chaar ki tasbeeh yeh hogi: (Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika lakal hamdu 'ala 'afwika ba'da qudratika) Aye Allah tu paak hai aur apni tareefon ke sath hai, tere hi liye sab tareef hai ke tu bawajood qudrat ke maaf farmata rehta hai. Abu Bakr bin Abdullah (Rahimahullah) kehte hain ke Arsh ko utarta dekh kar ahl-e-mahshar ki aankhein phat jayengi, jism kaanp uthenge, dil laraz jayenge. Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) farmate hain ke jis waqt Allah Azza-wa-Jal makhlooq ki taraf utrega toh darmiyan mein sattar hazaar parday honge, ba'z noor ke ba'z zulmat ke. Is zulmat mein se ek aisi aawaz niklegi jis se dil paash-paash ho jayenge, shayad un ki yeh riwayat inhi do theelon mein se li hui hogi, Wallahu A'lam. Us din sirf Allah hi ki badshahat hogi jaise farman hai: (Limanil mulkul yaum, lillahil wahidil qahhar) (Surah (Al-Ghafir: 16) Aaj mulk kis ke liye hai? Sirf Allah Ghalib-o-Qahhar ke liye. Sahih hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala aasmanon ko apne dahine haath se lapet lega aur zameenon ko apne dusre haath mein le lega phir farmayega main maalik hoon, main faisla karne wala hoon, zameen ke badshah kahan hain? Takabbur karne wale kahan hain? Woh din kuffar par bada bhari pada hoga. Isi ka bayan aur jagah bhi hai ke kafiron par woh din garan guzrega. Haan mominon ko us din mutlaq ghabrahat ya pareshani na hogi. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha gaya Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) pachaas hazaar saal ka din toh bahut hi daraz hoga. Aap ne farmaya us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai ke momin par toh woh ek waqt ki farz namaz se bhi halka aur aasaan hoga. Paighambar (A.S) ke tareeqay aur aap aur aap ke laye hue khulay haq se hat kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki raah ke siwa dusri raahon pe chalne wale us din bade hi nadim honge aur hasrat-o-afsos ke sath apne haath chabayenge. Go is ka nuzool Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait ke bare mein ho ya kisi aur ke bare mein lekin hukm ke aitbar se yeh har aise zalim ko shamil hai. Jaise farman hai: (Yauma tuqallabu wujuhuhum fin-nari yaquluna ya laitana ata'nallaha wa ata'nar-rasula) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 66) poori do aayaton tak. Pas har zalim Qayamat ke din pachtayega, apne hathon ko chabayega aur aah-o-zari karke kahega kaash ke main ne Nabi ki raah apnayi hoti. Kaash ke main ne falan ki aqeedat-mandi na ki hoti, jis ne mujhe raah-e-haq se gum kar diya. Umayyah bin Khalaf ka aur us ke bhai Ubay bin Khalaf ka bhi yahi haal hoga aur un ke siwa aur bhi aise logon ka yeh haal hoga. Kahega ke us ne mujhe zikr yani Quran se begana kar diya halankeh woh mujh tak pahunch chuka tha.

Allah Ta'ala farmata hai shaitan insaan ko ruswa karne wala hai, woh usey na-haq ki taraf bulata hai aur haq se hata deta hai.)))

Shikayat-e-Nabawi (ﷺ). Qayamat wale din Allah ke sache Rasool Aan-Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ) apni ummat ki shikayat Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein karenge ke na yeh log Quran ki taraf mail thay na raghbat se qabooliyat ke sath sunte thay balkay auron ko bhi is ke sunne se rokte thay jaise ke kuffar ka maqoola khud Quran mein hai ke woh kehte thay aayat (وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لَا تَسْمَعُوْا لِھٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنِ وَالْـغَوْا فِيْهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَغْلِبُوْنَ 26) (Surah (Fussilat: 26) is Quran ko na suno aur is ke parhe jaane ke waqt shor-o-ghul karo. Yehi is ka chor rakhna tha. Na is par imaan laate thay, na ise sacha jaante thay na is par ghor-o-fikr karte thay, na ise samajhne ki koshish karte thay na is par amal tha, na is ke ahkaam ko baja laate thay, na is ke mana karda kaamon se rukte thay balkay is ke siwa aur kalaamon se dilchaspi lete thay aur un par aamil thay, yehi ise chor dena tha. Hamari dua hai ke Allah Ta'ala Kareem-o-Mannan jo har cheez par qadir hai. Hamein taufeeq de ke hum is ke na-pasandeeda kaamon se dast-bardar ho jayen aur is ke pasandeeda kaamon ki taraf jhuk jayen. Woh hamein apne kalaam samjha de aur din raat is par amal karne ki hidayat de, jis se woh khush ho, woh Kareem Wahhab hai. Phir farmaya jis tarah ae Nabi aap ki qoum Quran ko nazar-andaz kar dene wale log hain. Isi tarah agli ummaton mein bhi aise log thay jo khud kufr karke dusron ko apne kufr mein shareek-e-kaar karte thay aur apni gumrahi ke phailane ki fikr mein lage rehte thay. Jaise farmaan hai aayat (وَكَذٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوًّا شَـيٰطِيْنَ الْاِنْسِ وَالْجِنِّ يُوْحِيْ بَعْضُهُمْ اِلٰى بَعْضٍ زُخْرُفَ الْقَوْلِ غُرُوْرًا ۭ وَلَوْ شَاۗءَ رَبُّكَ مَا فَعَلُوْهُ فَذَرْهُمْ وَمَا يَفْتَرُوْنَ) (Surah (Al-An'am: 112) yani isi tarah hum ne har Nabi ke dushman shayateen-e-ins-o-jinn bana diye hain phir farmaya jo Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki tabedari kare, Kitabullah par imaan laye, Allah ki wahi par yaqeen kare is ka haadi aur nasir khud Allah Ta'ala hai. Mushrikon ki jo khaslat upar bayan hui is se un ki gharz yeh thi ke logon ko hidayat par na aane dein aur aap musalmanon par ghalib rahein. Is liye Quran ne faisla kiya ke yeh na-murad hi rahenge. Allah apne nek bandon ko khud hidayat karega aur musalman ki khud madad karega. Yeh mamla aur aison ka muqabla kuch tujh se hi nahin tamam agle nabiyon ke sath yehi hota raha hai.))

Quran-e-Hakim mukhtalif auqat mein kyun utara. Kafiron ka ek aitraz yeh bhi tha ke jaise Taurat, Injeel, Zaboor, waghera ek sath paighambaron par nazil hoti rahin. Yeh Quran ek hi dafa An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par nazil kyun na hua? Allah Ta'ala ne is ke jawab mein farmaya ke haan waqai yeh mutafarriq taur par utra hai, bees baras mein nazil hua hai jaise jaise zaroorat padti gayi jo jo waqiat hote rahe ahkaam nazil hote gaye taake mominon ka dil jama rahe. Thehar thehar kar ahkaam utrein taake ek dam amal mushkil na ho pade, wazahat ke sath bayan ho jaye. Samajh mein aa jaye. Tafsir bhi sath hi sath hoti rahe. Hum un ke kul aitrazat ka sahi aur sacha jawab denge jo un ke bayan se bhi zyada wazeh hoga. Jo kami yeh bayan karenge hum un ki tasalli kar denge. Subh-o-Sham, raat din. Safar-o-hazar mein baar baar is Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki izzat aur apne khaas bandon ki hidayat ke liye hamara kalam hamare Nabi ki poori zindagi tak utarta raha. Jis se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki buzurgi aur fazilat bhi zahir hoti rahi lekin dusre ambiya (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) par ek hi martaba sara kalam utra magar is se behtareen Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala baar baar khitab karta ke is Quran ki azmat bhi aashkar ho jaye is liye yeh itni lambi muddat mein nazil hua. Pas Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi sab nabiyon mein aala aur Quran bhi sab kalamon mein bala. Aur lateefa yeh hai ke Quran ko dono buzurgiyan milin yeh ek sath Lauh-e-Mehfooz se Mala-e-Aala mein utra. Lauh-e-Mehfooz se poore ka poora duniya ke aasman tak pahuncha. Phir hasb-e-zaroorat thoda thoda kar ke nazil hota raha. Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain sara Quran ek dafa hi Lailatul Qadr mein duniya ke aasman par nazil hua phir bees saal tak zameen par utarta raha. Phir is ke suboot mein aap ne aayat (WALA YA’TUNAKA BIMATHALIN ILLA JI’NAKA BIL-HAQQI WA AHSANA TAFSIRO) (Surah (Al-Furqan: 33) aur aayat (WA QUR’ANAN FARAQNAHU LITAQRA’AHU ‘ALAN-NASI ‘ALA MUKTHIN WA NAZZALNAHU TANZILA) (Surah (Al-Isra: 106) tilawat farmayi. Is ke baad kafiron ki jo durgat Qayamat ke roz hone wali hai is ka bayan farmaya ke badtareen halat aur qabeeh tar zillat mein un ka hashr Jahannam ki taraf hoga. Yeh oondhe munh ghaseete jayenge yahi bure thikane wale aur sab se badh kar gumrah hain. Ek shakhs ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha ke kafiron ka hashr munh ke bal kaise hoga? Aap ne farmaya ke jis ne unhein pair ke bal chalaya woh sar ke bal chalane par bhi qadir hai.))

Anbiya se dushmani ka khamyaza: Allah Ta'ala mushrikeen ko aur Aap (ﷺ) ke mukhalifeen ko apne azabon se dara raha hai ke tum se pehle ke jin logon ne mere nabiyon ki na mani, un se dushmani ki, un ki mukhalifat ki, main ne unhein tehas-nehas kar diya. Firauniyon ka haal tum sun chuke ho ke Musa (A.S) aur Haroon (A.S) ko un ki taraf nabi bana kar bheja lekin unhon ne na mana jis ke ba'is Allah ka azab aa gaya aur sab halak kar diye gaye. Qaum-e-Nooh ko dekho unhon ne bhi hamare rasoolon ko jhutlaya aur chunke ek rasool ka jhutlana tamam nabiyon ko jhutlana hai, is waste yahan 'rusul' jama kar ke kaha gaya. Aur yeh is liye bhi ke agar bilfarz un ki taraf tamam rasool bhi bheje jate to bhi yeh sab ke sath wahi sulook karte jo Nooh (A.S) nabi ke sath kiya. Yeh matlab nahin ke un ki taraf bahut se rasool bheje gaye the, balkay un ke paas to sirf Hazrat Nooh (A.S) hi aaye the jo saarhay nau sau saal tak un mein rahe, har tarah unhein samjhaya bujhaya lekin siwaye madoode chand ke koi imaan na laya. Is liye Allah ne sab ko gharq kar diya. Siwaye un ke jo Hazrat Nooh (A.S) ke sath kashti mein the, ek bani-adam roo-e-zameen par na bacha. Logon ke liye un ki halakat ba'is-e-ibrat bana di gayi. Jaise farman hai ke pani ki tughyani ke waqt hum ne tumhein kashti mein sawar kar liya taake tum ise apne liye ba'is-e-ibrat banao aur kashti ko hum ne tumhare liye is toofan se nijat paane aur lambe lambe safar tay karne ka zariya bana diya taake tum Allah ki is ne'mat ko yaad rakho ke us ne alamgeer toofan se tumhein bacha liya aur imandaron ki aulad mein rakha. Aadiyon aur Samudiyon ka qissa to barha bayan ho chuka hai jaise ke Surah A'raf waghera mein. Ashab-ur-Rass ki babat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka qaul hai ke yeh Samudiyon ki ek basti wale the. Ikrama (R.H) farmate hain yeh khaleej wale the jin ka zikr Surah Yaseen mein hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se yeh bhi marwi hai ke Azerbaijan ke ek kunwein ke paas un ki basti thi. Ikrama farmate hain ke un ko kunwein wale is liye kaha jata hai kyunke unhon ne apne paighambar ko kunwein mein daal diya tha. Ibn Ishaq (R.H), Muhammad bin Ka'ab (R.H) se naqal karte hain ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ek siyah-faam ghulam sab se awwal jannat mein jayega. Allah Ta'ala ne ek basti walon ki taraf apna nabi bheja tha lekin un basti walon mein se bajuz is ke koi bhi imaan na laya, balkay unhon ne Allah ke nabi ko ek ghair-abad kunwein mein, veeran maidan mein daal diya aur us ke munh par ek bari bhari chattan rakh di ke yeh wahin mar jayen. Yeh ghulam jungle mein jata, lakriyan kaat kar lata, unhein bazaar mein farokht karta aur roti waghera khareed kar kunwein par aata, us pathar ko sarka deta. Yeh ek rassi mein latka kar roti aur pani us paighambar (A.S) ke paas pahuncha deta jise woh kha-pee lete. Muddaton tak yunhi hota raha. Ek martaba yeh gaya, lakriyan katin, chunein, jama keen, gathri bandhi, itne mein neend ka ghalba hua, so gaya. Allah Ta'ala ne is par neend daal di. Saat saal tak woh sota raha.

Yeh ek rassi mein latka kar roti aur pani us paighambar (A.S) ke paas pahuncha deta jise woh kha-pee lete. Muddaton tak yunhi hota raha. Qarn ki muddat ba'az ke nazdeek ek sau bees saal hai, koi kehta hai sau saal, koi kehta hai assi saal, koi kehta hai chalees saal aur bhi bahut se qaul hain. Zyada zahir baat yeh hai ke ek zamana wale ek qarn hain jab woh sab mar jayen toh dusra qarn shuru hota hai. Jaise Bukhari Muslim ki hadith mein hai sab se behtar zamana mera zamana hai. Phir farmata hai ke Sadum nami basti ke paas se toh yeh Arab barabar guzarte rehte hain. Yahin Luti abad the. Jin par zameen ulat di gayi aur aasman se pathar barsaye gaye aur bura meena un par barsa jo sanglakh patharon ka tha. Yeh din raat wahan se aamad-o-raft rakhte phir bhi aqalmandi ka kaam nahin lete. Yeh bastiyan toh tumhari guzargah hain un ke waqiat mashhoor hain kya tum unhein nahin dekhte? Yaqeenan dekhte ho lekin ibrat ki aankhein hi nahin ke samajh sako aur gaur karo ke apni badkariyon ki wajah se woh Allah ke azabon ke shikar ho gaye. Bas unhein ura diya gaya, be-nishan kar diye gaye. Buri tarah dhajjiyan bikher di gayin. Ise soche toh woh jo Qayamat ka qail ho. Lekin unhein kya ibrat hasil hogi jo Qayamat hi ke munkir hain. Dobara zindagi ko hi mahal jante hain.

Anbiya se dushmani ka khamyaza: Allah Ta'ala mushrikeen ko aur Aap (ﷺ) ke mukhalifeen ko apne azabon se dara raha hai ke tum se pehle ke jin logon ne mere nabiyon ki na mani, un se dushmani ki, un ki mukhalifat ki, main ne unhein tehas-nehas kar diya. Firauniyon ka haal tum sun chuke ho ke Musa (A.S) aur Haroon (A.S) ko un ki taraf nabi bana kar bheja lekin unhon ne na mana jis ke ba'is Allah ka azab aa gaya aur sab halak kar diye gaye. Qaum-e-Nooh ko dekho unhon ne bhi hamare rasoolon ko jhutlaya aur chunke ek rasool ka jhutlana tamam nabiyon ko jhutlana hai, is waste yahan 'rusul' jama kar ke kaha gaya. Aur yeh is liye bhi ke agar bilfarz un ki taraf tamam rasool bhi bheje jate to bhi yeh sab ke sath wahi sulook karte jo Nooh (A.S) nabi ke sath kiya. Yeh matlab nahin ke un ki taraf bahut se rasool bheje gaye the, balkay un ke paas to sirf Hazrat Nooh (A.S) hi aaye the jo saarhay nau sau saal tak un mein rahe, har tarah unhein samjhaya bujhaya lekin siwaye madoode chand ke koi imaan na laya. Is liye Allah ne sab ko gharq kar diya. Siwaye un ke jo Hazrat Nooh (A.S) ke sath kashti mein the, ek bani-adam roo-e-zameen par na bacha. Logon ke liye un ki halakat ba'is-e-ibrat bana di gayi. Jaise farman hai ke pani ki tughyani ke waqt hum ne tumhein kashti mein sawar kar liya taake tum ise apne liye ba'is-e-ibrat banao aur kashti ko hum ne tumhare liye is toofan se nijat paane aur lambe lambe safar tay karne ka zariya bana diya taake tum Allah ki is ne'mat ko yaad rakho ke us ne alamgeer toofan se tumhein bacha liya aur imandaron ki aulad mein rakha. Aadiyon aur Samudiyon ka qissa to barha bayan ho chuka hai jaise ke Surah A'raf waghera mein. Ashab-ur-Rass ki babat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka qaul hai ke yeh Samudiyon ki ek basti wale the. Ikrama (R.H) farmate hain yeh khaleej wale the jin ka zikr Surah Yaseen mein hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se yeh bhi marwi hai ke Azerbaijan ke ek kunwein ke paas un ki basti thi. Ikrama farmate hain ke un ko kunwein wale is liye kaha jata hai kyunke unhon ne apne paighambar ko kunwein mein daal diya tha. Ibn Ishaq (R.H), Muhammad bin Ka'ab (R.H) se naqal karte hain ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ek siyah-faam ghulam sab se awwal jannat mein jayega. Allah Ta'ala ne ek basti walon ki taraf apna nabi bheja tha lekin un basti walon mein se bajuz is ke koi bhi imaan na laya, balkay unhon ne Allah ke nabi ko ek ghair-abad kunwein mein, veeran maidan mein daal diya aur us ke munh par ek bari bhari chattan rakh di ke yeh wahin mar jayen. Yeh ghulam jungle mein jata, lakriyan kaat kar lata, unhein bazaar mein farokht karta aur roti waghera khareed kar kunwein par aata, us pathar ko sarka deta. Yeh ek rassi mein latka kar roti aur pani us paighambar (A.S) ke paas pahuncha deta jise woh kha-pee lete. Muddaton tak yunhi hota raha. Ek martaba yeh gaya, lakriyan katin, chunein, jama keen, gathri bandhi, itne mein neend ka ghalba hua, so gaya. Allah Ta'ala ne is par neend daal di. Saat saal tak woh sota raha.

Tujh se pehle ke rasoolon ka bhi mazaq uraya gaya. Kehne lage woh to kahiye ke hum jame rahe warna is rasool ne hamein behkane mein koi kami na rakhi thi. Aur qayam-e-hujjat ke baad, rasoolon ke pahunch chukne ke baad bhi Allah ki taraf nahin jhukte. Is ki tauheed aur Rasool (ﷺ) ki risalat ko nahin maante.)

Agar woh chahey toh raat din na badley. Allah Ta'ala ke wujood aur uski qudrat par daleelein bayan ho rahi hain ke mukhtalif aur mutazaad cheezon ko woh paida kar raha hai. Saaye ko woh barhata hai, kehte hain ke yeh waqt-e-sadiq se lekar suraj ke nikalne tak ka hai, agar woh chahta toh isey ek hi halat par rakh deta. Jaise farman hai ke agar woh raat hi raat rakhey toh koi din nahin kar sakta aur agar din hi din rakhey toh koi raat nahin la sakta. Agar suraj na nikalta toh saaye ka haal hi maloom na hota. Har cheez apni zidd se pehchani jaati hai, saaye ke peeche dhoop, dhoop ke peeche saaya bhi qudrat ka intezam hai. Phir sahaj sahaj hum isey yani saaye ko ya suraj ko apni taraf sameet lete hain. Ek ghat-ta jaata hai toh dusra barhta jaata hai aur yeh inqilab-e-sur'at se amal mein aata hai, koi jagah saaya-daar baqi nahin rehti, sirf gharon ke chhapron ke aur darakhton ke neeche saaya reh jaata hai aur un ke bhi oopar dhoop khuli hui hoti hai. Aahista aahista thora thora karke hum isey apni taraf sameet lete hain. Isi ne raat ko tumhare liye libas banaya hai ke woh tumhare wujood par chha jaati hai aur isey dhanp leti hai, jaise farman hai: Qasam hai raat ki jab ke dhanp ley. Isi ne neend ko sabab-e-rahat-o-sukoon banaya ke us waqt harkat mauqoof ho jaati hai aur din bhar ke kaam kaaj se jo thakan charh gayi thi woh is aaram se utar jaati hai. Badan ko aur rooh ko rahat hasil ho jaati hai. Phir din ko uth kharay hote ho, phail jaate ho aur rozi ki talash mein lag jaate ho. Jaise farman hai ke us ne apni rahmat se raat din muqarrar kar diya hai ke tum sukoon-o-aaram bhi hasil kar lo aur apni roziyan bhi talash karo.

Barish se pehle barish ki khushkhabri. Allah Ta'ala apni ek aur qudrat ka bayan farma raha hai ke woh barish se pehle barish ki khushkhabri dene wali hawayein chalata hai. In hawaon mein Rabb ne bahut se khawas rakhe hain. Ba'az badalon ko paraganda kar deti hain, ba'az unhein uthati hain, ba'az unhein le chalti hain, ba'az khunak aur bheegi hui chal kar logon ko baran-e-rahmat ki taraf mutawajja kar deti hain, ba'az is se pehle zameen ko tayyar kar deti hain, ba'az badalon ko pani se bhar deti hain aur unhein bojh-al kar deti hain. Aasman se hum pak saaf pani barsate hain ke woh pakeezgi ka aala bane. Yahan tahoor aisa hi hai jaisa sahoor aur wajoor waghera. Ba'az ne kaha hai ke yeh fa'ool ma'ani mein fa'il ke hai ya mubalagha ke liye mabni hai ya muta'addi ke liye. Yeh sab awal lughat aur hukm ke aitbar se mushkil hain. Poori tafseel ke laiq yeh maqam nahin, Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Thabit Bunani R.H ka bayan hai ke main Hazrat Abu Al-Aliyah R.H ke sath barish ke zamane mein nikla. Basre ke raste us waqt bade gande ho rahe the, aap ne aise raste par namaz ada ki. Main ne aap ki tawajjah dilayi to aap ne farmaya ise aasman ke pak pani ne pak kar diya. Allah farmata hai ke hum aasman se pak pani barsate hain. Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyab R.H farmate hain ke Allah ne ise pak utara hai ise koi cheez napak nahin karti. Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri R.A farmate hain ke Rasool Allah ﷺ se poocha gaya ke Bir-e-Baza'ah se wuzu kar lein? Yeh ek kunwan hai jis mein gandagi aur kutton ke gosht phenke jate hain. Aap ne farmaya pani pak hai ise koi cheez napak nahin karti. Imam Shafi aur Imam Ahmad ne ise warid ki hai. Imam Abu Dawood aur Imam Tirmidhi ne ise sahih kaha hai. Nasai mein bhi yeh riwayat hai. Abdul Malik bin Marwan ke darbar mein ek martaba pani ka zikr chida to Khalid bin Yazeed ne kaha ba'az pani aasman ke hote hain, ba'az pani woh hote hain jise badal samundar se peeta hai aur use garaj, kadak aur bijli meetha kar deti hai lekin is se zameen mein paidawar nahin hoti, han aasmani pani se paidawar ugti hai. Ikrimah R.H farmate hain aasman ke pani ke har qatra se chara, ghaas waghera paida hota hai ya samundar mein lulu aur moti paida hote hain, ya'ni fil-barri barrun wa fil-bahri durrun, zameen mein gehoon aur samundar mein moti. Phir farmaya ke isi se hum ghair-abad banjar khushk zameen ko zinda kar dete hain, woh leh-lahanay lagti hai aur taro-taza ho jati hai, jaise farman hai aayat (Fa-iza anzalna 'alaihal ma'a-htazzat wa rabat) (Surah (Fussilat: 39). Alawa murda zameen ke zinda ho jane ke, yeh pani haiwanon aur insanon ke peene mein aata hai, un ke kheton aur baghat ko pilaya jata hai. Jaise farman hai ke woh Allah wahi hai jo logon ki kamil na-umeedi ke baad un par barishein barsata hai. Aur aayat mein hai ke Allah ke aasar-e-rahmat ko dekho ke kis tarah murda zameen ko zinda kar deta hai.

Phir farmata hai saath hi meri qudrat ka ek nazara yeh bhi dekho ke abr uthta hai garajta hai lekin jahan main chahta hoon barasta hai is mein bhi hikmat-o-hujjat hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka qaul hai ke koi saal kisi saal kam-o-besh barish ka nahin lekin Allah jahan chahe barsaye jahan se chahe phere. Pas chahiye tha ke in nishanat ko dekh kar Allah ki in zabardast hikmaton ko aur qudraton ko samne rakh kar is baat ko bhi maan lete ke beshak hum dobara zinda kiye jayenge aur yeh bhi jaan lete ke barishein hamare gunahon ki shamat se band kar di jati hain to hum gunah chhod dein lekin in logon ne aisa na kiya balkay hamari nematon par aur nashukri ki. Ek mursal hadith Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) se kaha ke badal ki nisbat kuch puchna chahta hoon. Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ne farmaya badalon par jo farishta muqarrar hai woh yeh hai aap un se jo chahein daryaft farma lein. Us ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamare paas to Allah ka hukum aata hai ke falan falan shehar mein itne itne qatre barsao hum tameel-e-irshad karte hain. Barish jaisi nemat ke waqt aksar logon ke kufr ka tariqa yeh bhi hai ke woh kehte hain ke hum falan falan sitare ki wajah se yeh barish barsaye gaye. Chunancha sahi hadith mein hai ke ek martaba barish baras chukne ke baad Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya logo! jante ho tumhare Rab ne kya farmaya? Unhon ne kaha Allah aur us ka Rasool khoob janne wala hai. Aap ne farmaya suno! mere bandon mein se bahut se mere saath momin ho gaye aur bahut se kafir ho gaye jinhon ne kaha ke sirf Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam se yeh barish hum par barasi hai woh to mere saath iman rakhne wale aur sitaron se kufr karne wale hue aur jinhon ne kaha ke falan falan tare ke asar se pani barsaya gaya unhon ne mere saath kufr kiya aur taron par iman laye.)

An-Nabi kul aalam A.S agar Rabb chahta toh har har basti mein ek ek Nabi bhej deta lekin usne tamam duniya ki taraf sirf ek hi Nabi bheja hai aur phir use hukm de diya hai ke Quran ka wa'z sab ko suna de. Jaise farman hai ke main is Quran se tumhein aur jis jis ko yeh pahunche hoshiyar kar doon aur un tamam jamaton mein se jo bhi is se kufr kare uske thaharne ki jagah Jahannam hai aur farman hai ke tum Makkah walon ko aur charon taraf ke logon ko aagah kar do. Aur aayat mein hai ke ae Nabi aap kah dijiye ke ae tamam logo! Main tum sab ki taraf Rasool-e-Allah ﷺ ban kar aaya hoon. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai main surkh-o-siyah sab ki taraf bheja gaya hoon. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki aur hadith mein hai ke tamam Anbiya apni apni qoum ki taraf bheje jaate rahe aur main aam logon ki taraf mab'oos kiya gaya hoon. Phir farmaya kafiron ka kahna na manna aur is Quran ke sath un se bahut bada jihad karna. Jaise irshad hai. Aayat (Yaa Ayyuhan-Nabiyyu jahidil-kuffara wal-munafiqina waghluz 'alaihim, wa ma'wahum Jahannamu wa bi'sal-masir) (At-Tahrim: 9) yani ae Nabi kafiron se aur munafiqon se jihad karte raho. Isi Rabb ne pani ko do tarah ka kar diya hai. Meetha aur khari. Nehron, chashmon aur kunwon ka pani umooman shireen, saaf aur khush-zaiqa hota hai. Ba'z thahre hue samundaron ka pani khari aur bad-maza hota hai. Allah ki is ne'mat par bhi shukr karna chahiye ke usne meethe pani ki charon taraf rail-pel kar di taake logon ko nahane dhone, peene aur khet aur baghat ko pani dene mein aasani rahe. Mashriqon aur maghribon mein muheet samundar khari pani ke usne baha diye jo thahre hue hain, idhar udhar behte nahin lekin maujein maar rahe hain, talatum paida kar rahe hain, ba'z mein madd-o-jazar hai, har mahine ki ibtidai tareekhon mein toh un mein ziyadati aur bahao hota hai phir chand ke ghatne ke sath woh ghat-ta jaata hai yahan tak aakhir mein apni halat par aa jaata hai phir jahan chand chadha yeh bhi chadhne laga chaudah tareekh tak barabar chand ke sath chadh-ta raha phir utarna shuru hua. In tamam samundaron ko isi Allah ne paida kiya hai woh poori aur zabardast qudrat wala hai. Khari aur garam pani go peene ke kaam nahin aata lekin hawaon ko saaf kar deta hai jis se insani zindagi halakat mein na pade is mein jo janwar mar jaate hain un ki badbu duniya walon ko sata nahin sakti aur khari pani ke sabab se is ki hawa sehat-bakhsh aur iska murda paak-o-tayyib hota hai. Aan-Hazrat ﷺ se jab samundar ke pani ki nisbat sawal hua ke kya hum is se wuzu kar lein? Toh aap ne farmaya iska pani paak hai aur iska murda halal hai. Malik, Shafi'i aur Ahl-e-Sunan R.H ne ise riwayat ki hai aur asnaad bhi sahih hai. Phir iski qudrat dekho ke mahaz apni taqat se aur apne hukm se ek dusre se juda rakha hai na khari meethe mein mil sake na meetha khari mein mil sake. Jaise farman hai aayat (Marajal-bahraini yaltaqiyan) (Ar-Rahman: 19).

(Ar-Rahman: 19) Us ne dono samundar jaari kar diye hain ke dono mil jayen aur un dono ke darmiyan ek hijaab qaim kar diya hai ke had se na barhein. Phir tum apne Rab ki kis kis ne'amat ke munkir ho? Aur aayat mein hai, kaun hai woh jis ne zameen ko jaye-qarar banaya aur is mein jagah jagah darya jaari kar diye, is par pahar qaim kar diye aur do samundaron ke darmiyan oat kar di. Kya Allah ke saath aur koi ma'abood bhi hai? Baat yeh hai ke in mushrikeen ke aksar log be-ilm hain. Us ne insaan ko za'eef nutfay se paida kiya hai, phir usay theek-thaak aur barabar banaya hai. Aur achi paidaish mein paida karke phir usay mard ya aurat banaya. Phir us ke liye nasab ke rishtedar bana diye, phir kuch muddat baad sasural ke rishtay qaim kar diye. Itne baray Qadir Allah ki qudratein tumhare samne hain.
