Aabai gumrahi: Mushrikon ki jahalat bayan ho rahi hai ke woh but-parasti karte hain aur bila-daleel-o-hujjat un ki pooja karte hain jo na nafa ke malik na nuqsan ke. Sirf baap-dadon ki dekha-dekhi nafsani khwahishat se unki mohabbat-o-azmat apne dilon mein jamaye hue hain aur Allah-o-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se dushmani aur mukhalifat rakhte hain. Shaitani lashkar mein shamil ho gaye hain aur Rahmani lashkar ke mukhalif ho gaye hain lekin yaad rakhein ke anjam-e-kaar ghalba Allah walon ko hi hoga. Yeh khwah-makhwah un ki taraf se seena-sipar ho rahe hain anjam-e-kaar mominon ke hi hath rahega. Dunya aur aakhirat mein un ka Parwardigar unki imdad karega. In kuffar ko to shaitan sirf Allah ki mukhalifat par ubhar deta hai aur kuch nahin. Sachay Allah ki adawat inke dil mein daal deta hai, shirk ki mohabbat bitha deta hai, yeh Allah ke ahkaam se peeth pher lete hain. Phir Allah Ta'ala apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se khitab karke farmata hai ke hum ne tumhein mominon ko khushkhabri sunane wala aur kuffar ko darane wala bana kar bheja hai. Itaat-guzaron ko jannat ki basharat dijiye aur nafarmanon ko jahannam ke azabon se mutalla farma dijiye. Logon mein aam taur par elaan kar dijiye ke main apni tableegh ka badla, apne wa'az ka muawza tum se nahin chahta. Mera irada siwaye Allah ki razamandi ki talash ke aur kuch nahin. Main sirf yeh chahta hoon ke tum mein se jo rah-e-rast par aana chahe us ke samne sahih rasta numaya kar doon. Ae Paighambar! Apne tamam kamon mein us Allah par bharosa rakhiye jo hamesha aur dawam wala hai, jo maut-o-faut se paak hai, jo Awwal-o-Aakhir, Zahir-o-Batin aur har cheez ka aalim hai, jo da'im baqi, sarmadi, abadi, Hayy-o-Qayyum hai, jo har cheez ka malik aur Rabb hai, usko apna mawa-o-malja thehra lein. Usi ki zaat aisi hai ke us par tawakkul kiya jaye, har ghabrahat mein usi ki taraf jhuka jaye. Woh kaafi hai, wahi nasir hai, wahi muayyad-o-muzaffar hai. Jaise farman hai aayat (Yaa Ayyuhar Rasoolu balligh maa unzila ilaika mir Rabbik - 5. (Al-Ma'idah: 67) Ae Nabi! Jo kuch aap ke Rabb ki janib se utara gaya hai use pahuncha dijiye. Agar aap ne yeh na kiya to aap ne haq-e-risalat ada nahin kiya. Aap be-fikr rahiye Allah aap ko logon ke bure iradon se bacha lega. Ek mursal hadith mein hai ke Madine ki kisi gali mein Hazrat Salman (R.A) Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko sajda karne lage to aap ne farmaya: Ae Salman! Mujhe sajda na kar, sajde ke laiq woh hai jo hamesha ki zindagi wala hai, jis par kabhi maut nahin (Ibn Abi Hatim). Aur us ki tasbeeh-o-hamd bayan karta reh, chunancha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) uski tameel mein farmaya karte the, dua: (Subhanak Allahumma Rabbana wa bihamdik). Murad is se yeh hai ke ibadat Allah hi ki kar, tawakkul sirf usi ki zaat par kar, jaise farman hai: Mashriq-o-Maghrib ka Rabb wahi hai, us ke siwa koi mabood nahin, to usi ko apna karsaz samajh. Aur jagah hai aayat (Fa'budhu wa tawakkal alaih, wa ma Rabbuka bi-ghafilin amma ta'maloon - 11. (Hud: 123).

(Hud: 123) Usi ki ibadat kar, usi par bharosa rakh. Aur aayat mein hai, elaan karde ke usi Rahman ke hum bande hain aur usi par hamara kaamil bharosa hai. Is par bandon ke sab aamal zahir hain. Koi ek zarra bhi us se posheeda nahin, koi pur-asrar baat bhi us se makhfi nahin. Wohi tamam cheezon ka khaliq hai, malik-o-qabiz hai, wohi har jaandar ka rozi-rasan hai. Us ne apni qudrat-o-azmat se aasman-o-zameen jaisi zabardast makhlooq ko sirf chhe din mein paida kardiya, phir Arsh par qarar pakda hai. Kaamon ki tadbeeron ka anjam usi ki taraf se aur usi ke hukum aur tadbeer ka marhoon-e-minnat hai. Us ka faisla aala aur achha hi hota hai. Jo zaat-e-Ilah ka aalim ho aur sifat-e-Ilah se aagah ho, us se us ki shaan daryaft karle. Yeh zahir hai ke Allah ki zaat ki poori khabardari rakhne wale, us ki zaat se poore waqif Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hi the. Jo duniya aur aakhirat mein tamam aulad-e-Adam ke ala-al-itlaq sardar the. Jo ek baat bhi apni taraf se nahin kehte the, balkeh jo farmate the woh farmuda-e-Ilah hi hota tha. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jo jo sifatain Allah ki bayan keen sab bar-haq hain, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jo khabrein deen sab sach hain. Sache Imam aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hi hain, tamam jhagron ka faisla aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hi ke hukum se kiya ja sakta hai. Jo aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki baat batlaye woh sacha, jo aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke khilaf kahe woh mardood, khwah koi bhi ho. Allah ka farman wajib-ul-iz'aan khule taur se sadir ho chuka hai. Aayat (Fa-in tanaza'tum fi shai-in farudduhu ilallahi war-rasuli in kuntum tu'minuna billahi wal-yaumil-akhiri zalika khairun wa ahsanu ta'wila) (Surah (An-Nisa: 59). Tum agar kisi cheez mein jhagro to use Allah aur us ke Rasool ki taraf lautao. Aur farman hai aayat (Wa ma ikhtalaftum fihi min shai-in fahukmuhu ilallahi, zalikumullahu Rabbi 'alaihi tawakkaltu wa ilaihi unib) (Surah (Ash-Shura: 10). Tum jis cheez mein bhi ikhtilaf karo us ka faisla Allah ki taraf hai. Aur farman hai (Wa tammat kalimatu Rabbika sidqan wa 'adlan, la mubaddila likalimatihi, wa huwas-sami'ul-'alim) (Surah (Al-An'am: 115). Tere Rabb ki baatein jo khabron mein sachi aur hukum-o-muman'at mein adl ki hain, poori ho chukin. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke murad is se Quran hai. Mushrikeen Allah ke siwa auron ko sajde karte the. Un se jab Rahman ko sajda karne ko kaha jata tha to kehte the ke hum Rahman ko nahin jante. Woh is se munkir the ke Allah ka naam Rahman hai, jaise Hudaibiyah wale saal Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne sulh-nama ke katib se farmaya, "Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim" likh. To mushrikeen ne kaha, na hum Rahman ko janen na Rahim ko, hamare riwaj ke mutabiq "Bismika Allahumma" likh. Is ke jawab mein yeh aayat utri: Aayat (Qulid'ullaha awid'ur-Rahmana ayyam-ma tad'u falahul-asma'ul-husna, wa la tajhar bisalatika wa la tukhafit biha wabtaghi baina zalika sabila) (Surah (Al-Isra: 110).

(Al-Isra: 110), keh de ke Allah ko pukaro ya Rahman ko, jis naam se chaho pukaro, us ke bohat se behtareen naam hain. Wohi Allah hai, wohi Rahman hai. Pas mushrikeen kehte thay ke kya sirf tere kehne se hum aisa maan lein? Al-gharaz woh aur nafrat mein barh gaye, bar-khilaf momino ke ke woh Allah ki ibadat karte hain jo Rahman-o-Raheem hai, usi ko ibadat ke laiq samajhte hain aur usi ke liye sajda karte hain. Ulama (Rahimahumullah) ka ittefaq hai ke Surah Furqan ki is aayat ke parhne aur sunne wale par sajda mashroo hai, jaise ke us ki jagah is ki tafseel majood hai. Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam.))))))

Aabai gumrahi: Mushrikon ki jahalat bayan ho rahi hai ke woh but-parasti karte hain aur bila-daleel-o-hujjat un ki pooja karte hain jo na nafa ke malik na nuqsan ke. Sirf baap-dadon ki dekha-dekhi nafsani khwahishat se unki mohabbat-o-azmat apne dilon mein jamaye hue hain aur Allah-o-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se dushmani aur mukhalifat rakhte hain. Shaitani lashkar mein shamil ho gaye hain aur Rahmani lashkar ke mukhalif ho gaye hain lekin yaad rakhein ke anjam-e-kaar ghalba Allah walon ko hi hoga. Yeh khwah-makhwah un ki taraf se seena-sipar ho rahe hain anjam-e-kaar mominon ke hi hath rahega. Dunya aur aakhirat mein un ka Parwardigar unki imdad karega. In kuffar ko to shaitan sirf Allah ki mukhalifat par ubhar deta hai aur kuch nahin. Sachay Allah ki adawat inke dil mein daal deta hai, shirk ki mohabbat bitha deta hai, yeh Allah ke ahkaam se peeth pher lete hain. Phir Allah Ta'ala apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se khitab karke farmata hai ke hum ne tumhein mominon ko khushkhabri sunane wala aur kuffar ko darane wala bana kar bheja hai. Itaat-guzaron ko jannat ki basharat dijiye aur nafarmanon ko jahannam ke azabon se mutalla farma dijiye. Logon mein aam taur par elaan kar dijiye ke main apni tableegh ka badla, apne wa'az ka muawza tum se nahin chahta. Mera irada siwaye Allah ki razamandi ki talash ke aur kuch nahin. Main sirf yeh chahta hoon ke tum mein se jo rah-e-rast par aana chahe us ke samne sahih rasta numaya kar doon. Ae Paighambar! Apne tamam kamon mein us Allah par bharosa rakhiye jo hamesha aur dawam wala hai, jo maut-o-faut se paak hai, jo Awwal-o-Aakhir, Zahir-o-Batin aur har cheez ka aalim hai, jo da'im baqi, sarmadi, abadi, Hayy-o-Qayyum hai, jo har cheez ka malik aur Rabb hai, usko apna mawa-o-malja thehra lein. Usi ki zaat aisi hai ke us par tawakkul kiya jaye, har ghabrahat mein usi ki taraf jhuka jaye. Woh kaafi hai, wahi nasir hai, wahi muayyad-o-muzaffar hai. Jaise farman hai aayat (Yaa Ayyuhar Rasoolu balligh maa unzila ilaika mir Rabbik - 5. (Al-Ma'idah: 67) Ae Nabi! Jo kuch aap ke Rabb ki janib se utara gaya hai use pahuncha dijiye. Agar aap ne yeh na kiya to aap ne haq-e-risalat ada nahin kiya. Aap be-fikr rahiye Allah aap ko logon ke bure iradon se bacha lega. Ek mursal hadith mein hai ke Madine ki kisi gali mein Hazrat Salman (R.A) Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko sajda karne lage to aap ne farmaya: Ae Salman! Mujhe sajda na kar, sajde ke laiq woh hai jo hamesha ki zindagi wala hai, jis par kabhi maut nahin (Ibn Abi Hatim). Aur us ki tasbeeh-o-hamd bayan karta reh, chunancha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) uski tameel mein farmaya karte the, dua: (Subhanak Allahumma Rabbana wa bihamdik). Murad is se yeh hai ke ibadat Allah hi ki kar, tawakkul sirf usi ki zaat par kar, jaise farman hai: Mashriq-o-Maghrib ka Rabb wahi hai, us ke siwa koi mabood nahin, to usi ko apna karsaz samajh. Aur jagah hai aayat (Fa'budhu wa tawakkal alaih, wa ma Rabbuka bi-ghafilin amma ta'maloon - 11. (Hud: 123).

(Hud: 123) Usi ki ibadat kar, usi par bharosa rakh. Aur aayat mein hai, elaan karde ke usi Rahman ke hum bande hain aur usi par hamara kaamil bharosa hai. Is par bandon ke sab aamal zahir hain. Koi ek zarra bhi us se posheeda nahin, koi pur-asrar baat bhi us se makhfi nahin. Wohi tamam cheezon ka khaliq hai, malik-o-qabiz hai, wohi har jaandar ka rozi-rasan hai. Us ne apni qudrat-o-azmat se aasman-o-zameen jaisi zabardast makhlooq ko sirf chhe din mein paida kardiya, phir Arsh par qarar pakda hai. Kaamon ki tadbeeron ka anjam usi ki taraf se aur usi ke hukum aur tadbeer ka marhoon-e-minnat hai. Us ka faisla aala aur achha hi hota hai. Jo zaat-e-Ilah ka aalim ho aur sifat-e-Ilah se aagah ho, us se us ki shaan daryaft karle. Yeh zahir hai ke Allah ki zaat ki poori khabardari rakhne wale, us ki zaat se poore waqif Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hi the. Jo duniya aur aakhirat mein tamam aulad-e-Adam ke ala-al-itlaq sardar the. Jo ek baat bhi apni taraf se nahin kehte the, balkeh jo farmate the woh farmuda-e-Ilah hi hota tha. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jo jo sifatain Allah ki bayan keen sab bar-haq hain, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jo khabrein deen sab sach hain. Sache Imam aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hi hain, tamam jhagron ka faisla aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hi ke hukum se kiya ja sakta hai. Yeh zahir hai ke Allah ki zaat ki poori khabardari rakhne wale, us ki zaat se poore waqif Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hi the. Jo duniya aur aakhirat mein tamam aulad-e-Adam ke ala-al-itlaq sardar the. Jo ek baat bhi apni taraf se nahin kehte the, balkeh jo farmate the woh farmuda-e-Ilah hi hota tha. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jo jo sifatain Allah ki bayan keen sab bar-haq hain, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jo khabrein deen sab sach hain. Sache Imam aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hi hain, tamam jhagron ka faisla aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hi ke hukum se kiya ja sakta hai. Jo aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki baat batlaye woh sacha, jo aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke khilaf kahe woh mardood, khwah koi bhi ho. Allah ka farman wajib-ul-iz'aan khule taur se sadir ho chuka hai. Aayat (Fa-in tanaza'tum fi shai-in farudduhu ilallahi war-rasuli in kuntum tu'minuna billahi wal-yaumil-akhiri zalika khairun wa ahsanu ta'wila) (Surah (An-Nisa: 59). Tum agar kisi cheez mein jhagro to use Allah aur us ke Rasool ki taraf lautao. Aur farman hai aayat (Wa ma ikhtalaftum fihi min shai-in fahukmuhu ilallahi, zalikumullahu Rabbi 'alaihi tawakkaltu wa ilaihi unib) (Surah (Ash-Shura: 10). Tum jis cheez mein bhi ikhtilaf karo us ka faisla Allah ki taraf hai. Aur farman hai (Wa tammat kalimatu Rabbika sidqan wa 'adlan, la mubaddila likalimatihi, wa huwas-sami'ul-'alim) (Surah (Al-An'am: 115). Tere Rabb ki baatein jo khabron mein sachi aur hukum-o-muman'at mein adl ki hain, poori ho chukin. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke murad is se Quran hai. Mushrikeen Allah ke siwa auron ko sajde karte the. Un se jab Rahman ko sajda karne ko kaha jata tha to kehte the ke hum Rahman ko nahin jante. Woh is se munkir the ke Allah ka naam Rahman hai, jaise Hudaibiyah wale saal Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne sulh-nama ke katib se farmaya, "Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim" likh. To mushrikeen ne kaha, na hum Rahman ko janen na Rahim ko, hamare riwaj ke mutabiq "Bismika Allahumma" likh. Is ke jawab mein yeh aayat utri: Aayat (Qulid'ullaha awid'ur-Rahmana ayyam-ma tad'u falahul-asma'ul-husna, wa la tajhar bisalatika wa la tukhafit biha wabtaghi baina zalika sabila) (Surah (Al-Isra: 110).

(Al-Isra: 110), keh de ke Allah ko pukaro ya Rahman ko, jis naam se chaho pukaro, us ke bohat se behtareen naam hain. Wohi Allah hai, wohi Rahman hai. Pas mushrikeen kehte thay ke kya sirf tere kehne se hum aisa maan lein? Al-gharaz woh aur nafrat mein barh gaye, bar-khilaf momino ke ke woh Allah ki ibadat karte hain jo Rahman-o-Raheem hai, usi ko ibadat ke laiq samajhte hain aur usi ke liye sajda karte hain. Ulama (Rahimahumullah) ka ittefaq hai ke Surah Furqan ki is aayat ke parhne aur sunne wale par sajda mashroo hai, jaise ke us ki jagah is ki tafseel majood hai. Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam.))))))

Aabai gumrahi: Mushrikon ki jahalat bayan ho rahi hai ke woh but-parasti karte hain aur bila-daleel-o-hujjat un ki pooja karte hain jo na nafa ke malik na nuqsan ke. Sirf baap-dadon ki dekha-dekhi nafsani khwahishat se unki mohabbat-o-azmat apne dilon mein jamaye hue hain aur Allah-o-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se dushmani aur mukhalifat rakhte hain. Shaitani lashkar mein shamil ho gaye hain aur Rahmani lashkar ke mukhalif ho gaye hain lekin yaad rakhein ke anjam-e-kaar ghalba Allah walon ko hi hoga. Yeh khwah-makhwah un ki taraf se seena-sipar ho rahe hain anjam-e-kaar mominon ke hi hath rahega. Dunya aur aakhirat mein un ka Parwardigar unki imdad karega. In kuffar ko to shaitan sirf Allah ki mukhalifat par ubhar deta hai aur kuch nahin. Sachay Allah ki adawat inke dil mein daal deta hai, shirk ki mohabbat bitha deta hai, yeh Allah ke ahkaam se peeth pher lete hain. Phir Allah Ta'ala apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se khitab karke farmata hai ke hum ne tumhein mominon ko khushkhabri sunane wala aur kuffar ko darane wala bana kar bheja hai. Itaat-guzaron ko jannat ki basharat dijiye aur nafarmanon ko jahannam ke azabon se mutalla farma dijiye. Logon mein aam taur par elaan kar dijiye ke main apni tableegh ka badla, apne wa'az ka muawza tum se nahin chahta. Mera irada siwaye Allah ki razamandi ki talash ke aur kuch nahin. Main sirf yeh chahta hoon ke tum mein se jo rah-e-rast par aana chahe us ke samne sahih rasta numaya kar doon. Ae Paighambar! Apne tamam kamon mein us Allah par bharosa rakhiye jo hamesha aur dawam wala hai, jo maut-o-faut se paak hai, jo Awwal-o-Aakhir, Zahir-o-Batin aur har cheez ka aalim hai, jo da'im baqi, sarmadi, abadi, Hayy-o-Qayyum hai, jo har cheez ka malik aur Rabb hai, usko apna mawa-o-malja thehra lein. Usi ki zaat aisi hai ke us par tawakkul kiya jaye, har ghabrahat mein usi ki taraf jhuka jaye. Woh kaafi hai, wahi nasir hai, wahi muayyad-o-muzaffar hai. Jaise farman hai aayat (Yaa Ayyuhar Rasoolu balligh maa unzila ilaika mir Rabbik - 5. (Al-Ma'idah: 67) Ae Nabi! Jo kuch aap ke Rabb ki janib se utara gaya hai use pahuncha dijiye. Agar aap ne yeh na kiya to aap ne haq-e-risalat ada nahin kiya. Aap be-fikr rahiye Allah aap ko logon ke bure iradon se bacha lega. Ek mursal hadith mein hai ke Madine ki kisi gali mein Hazrat Salman (R.A) Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko sajda karne lage to aap ne farmaya: Ae Salman! Mujhe sajda na kar, sajde ke laiq woh hai jo hamesha ki zindagi wala hai, jis par kabhi maut nahin (Ibn Abi Hatim). Aur us ki tasbeeh-o-hamd bayan karta reh, chunancha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) uski tameel mein farmaya karte the, dua: (Subhanak Allahumma Rabbana wa bihamdik). Murad is se yeh hai ke ibadat Allah hi ki kar, tawakkul sirf usi ki zaat par kar, jaise farman hai: Mashriq-o-Maghrib ka Rabb wahi hai, us ke siwa koi mabood nahin, to usi ko apna karsaz samajh. Aur jagah hai aayat (Fa'budhu wa tawakkal alaih, wa ma Rabbuka bi-ghafilin amma ta'maloon - 11. (Hud: 123).

Allah Ta'ala ki rif'at-o-azmat Allah Ta'ala ki barai, qudrat, rif'at ko dekho ke usne aasman mein burj banaye is se murad ya toh bade bade sitare hain ya chaukidari ke burj hain. Pehla qaul zyada zahir hai aur ho sakta hai ke bade bade sitaron se murad bhi yahi burj hon. Aur aayat mein hai aasman-e-dunya ko hum ne sitaron ke sath muzayyan banaya. Siraj se murad suraj hai jo chamakta rehta hai aur misl-e-charagh ke hai jaise farman hai aayat (Wa ja'alna sirajan wahhajan 78. (An-Naba: 13) aur hum ne roshan charagh yani suraj banaya aur chand banaya jo munawwar aur roshan hai dusre noor se jo suraj ke siwa hai. Jaise farman hai ke usne suraj ko roshan banaya aur chand ko noor banaya. Hazrat Nuh A.S ne apni qaum se farmaya aayat (Alam tarau kaifa khalaqallahu sab'a samawatin tibaqan 71. (Nuh: 15) kya tum dekh nahin rahe ke Allah Ta'ala ne upar tale saat aasman paida kiye aur un mein chand ko noor banaya aur suraj ko charagh banaya. Din raat ek dusre ke peeche aane jaane mein uski qudrat ka nizam hai. Yeh jata hai woh aata hai uska jana uska aana hai. Jaise farman hai usne tumhare liye suraj chand pai dar pai aane jaane wale banaye hain. Aur jagah hai raat din ko dhanp leti hai aur jaldi jaldi use talab karti aati hai. Na suraj chand se aage badh sake na raat din se sabqat le sake. Isi se uske bandon ko uski ibadaton ke waqt maloom hote hain raat ka faut shuda amal din mein pura kar lein. Din ka reh gaya hua amal raat ko ada kar lein. Sahih hadith sharif mein hai Allah Ta'ala raat ko apne hath phailata hai taake din ka gunahgar tauba kar le aur din ko hath phailata hai ke raat ka gunahgar tauba kar le. Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A ne ek din Zuha ki namaz mein badi der laga di. Sawal par farmaya ke raat ka mera wazifa kuch baqi reh gaya tha toh main ne chaha ke use pura ya qaza kar loon. Phir aap ne yahi aayat tilawat farmayi. Khilfata ka ek matlab yeh bhi hai ke mukhtalif yani din roshan raat tareek is mein ujala is mein andhera yeh noorani aur woh zulmati.))

(Nuh: 15) kya tum dekh nahin rahe ke Allah Ta'ala ne upar tale saat aasman paida kiye aur un mein chand ko noor banaya aur suraj ko charagh banaya. Din ka reh gaya hua amal raat ko ada kar lein. Sahih hadith sharif mein hai Allah Ta'ala raat ko apne hath phailata hai taake din ka gunahgar tauba kar le aur din ko hath phailata hai ke raat ka gunahgar tauba kar le. Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A ne ek din Zuha ki namaz mein badi der laga di. Sawal par farmaya ke raat ka mera wazifa kuch baqi reh gaya tha toh main ne chaha ke use pura ya qaza kar loon. Phir aap ne yahi aayat tilawat farmayi. Khilfata ka ek matlab yeh bhi hai ke mukhtalif yani din roshan raat tareek is mein ujala is mein andhera yeh noorani aur woh zulmati.))

Mominon ka kirdar: Allah ke momin bandon ke ausaf bayan ho rahe hain ke woh zameen par sukoon-o-waqar ke sath, tawazo, aajizi, maskeeni aur farotani se chalte phirte hain. Takabbur, tajabbur, fasad aur zulm-o-sitam nahin karte, jaise Hazrat Luqman (R.H) ne apne larke se farmaya tha ke akar kar na chala kar. Magar iska yeh matlab hargiz nahin ke tasannu aur banawat se kamar jhuka kar beemaron ki tarah qadam qadam chalna, yeh toh riyakaron ka kaam hai ke woh apne aap ko dikhane ke liye aur duniya ki nigahein apni taraf uthane ke liye aisa karte hain. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aadat iske bilkul bar-aks thi. Aap ki chaal aisi thi ke goya aap kisi unchai se utar rahe hain aur goya ke zameen aap ke liye lipti ja rahi hai. Salaf-e-Saliheen ne beemaron ki si takalluf wali chaal ko makrooh farmaya hai. Farooq-e-Azam (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne ek naujawan ko dekha ke woh bahut ahista ahista chal raha hai, aap ne us se daryaft farmaya ke kya tu kuch beemar hai? Usne kaha nahin. Aap ne farmaya phir yeh kya chaal hai? Khabardar jo ab is tarah chala toh kore khaye ga. Taaqat ke sath jaldi jaldi chala karo. Pas yahan murad taskeen aur waqar ke sath sharifana chaal chalna hai na ke zaeefana aur mareezana. Chunancha ek hadith mein hai ke jab namaz ke liye aao toh daur kar na aao balkeh taskeen ke sath aao. Jo jamaat ke sath mil jayein ada kar lo aur jo faut ho jaye poori kar lo. Imam Hasan Basri (R.H) ne is ayat ki tafseer mein nihayat hi umdah baat irshad farmayi hai ke mominon ki aankhein aur un ke kaan aur un ke aaza jhuke hue aur ruke hue rehte hain, yahan tak ke ganwar aur be-waqoof log unhein beemar samajh lete hain halankeh woh beemar nahin hote balkeh khauf-e-Ilahi se jhuke jate hain. Waise pooray tandurust hain lekin dil Allah ke khauf se pur hain. Aakhirat ka ilm duniya talbi se aur yahan ke thaath se unhein roke hue hai. Yeh qayamat ke din kahenge ke Allah ka shukr hai jis ne hum se gham ko door kar diya. Is se koi yeh na samajh le ke unhein duniya mein khane peene waghera ka gham laga rehta tha, nahin nahin Allah ki qasam duniya ka koi gham un ke paas bhi nahin phatakta tha. Haan unhein aakhirat ka khatka har waqt laga rehta tha, jannat ke kisi kaam ko woh bhari nahin samajhte the, haan jahannam ka khauf unhein rulata rehta tha. Jo shakhs Allah ke khauf dilane se bhi khauf na khaye us ka nafs hasraton ka malik hai. Jo shakhs khane peene ko hi Allah ki nemat samjhe woh kam-ilm hai aur azabon mein phansa hua hai. Phir apne nek bandon ka aur wasf bayan farmaya ke jab jahil log un se jahalat ki baatein karte hain toh yeh bhi un ki tarah jahalat par nahin utarte balkeh darguzar kar lete hain, maaf farma dete hain aur siwaye bhali baat ke gandi baton se apni zaban aalooda nahin karte. Jaise Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aadat-e-mubarak thi ke joon joon doosra aap par tez hota aap utne hi narm hote.

Yehi wasf Quran-e-Kareem ki is aayat mein bayan hua hai aayat (Wa iza sami'ul laghwa a'razu anhu wa qalu lana a'maluna wa lakum a'malukum, salamun alaikum la nabtaghil jahilin) (Surah (Al-Qasas: 55). Momin log behuda baatein sun kar munh pher lete hain. Ek husn sanad se Musnad-e-Ahmad mein marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne kisi shakhs ne dusre ko bura bhala kaha lekin usne palat kar jawab diya ke tujh par salam ho. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tum dono ke darmiyan farishta majood tha woh teri taraf se gaaliyan dene wale ko jawab deta tha, woh jo gaali tujhe deta tha farishta kehta tha yeh nahin balkay tu, aur jab tu kehta tha tujh par salam to farishta kehta tha is par nahin balkay tujh par, tu hi salamti ka pura haqdar hai. Pas farman hai ke yeh apni zaban ko gandi nahin karte, bura kehne walon ko bura nahin kehte, siwaye bhale kalmay ke zaban se aur koi lafz nahin nikalte. Imam Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain dusra in par zulm kare yeh sulh aur bardasht karte hain. Allah ke bandon ke sath din is tarah guzarte hain ke un ki karwi kasili sun lete hain, raat ko jis halat mein guzarte hain us ka bayan agli aayat mein hai. Farmata hai ke raat Allah ki ibadat aur us ki ita'at mein basar hoti hai, bahut kam sote hain, subh ko istighfar karte hain, karwatein bistaron se alag rehti hain, dilon mein Allah ka khauf hota hai, umeed-e-rahmat hoti hai aur raton ki ghariyon ko Allah ki ibadaton mein guzarte hain. Duayein mangte hain ke Aye Allah azab-e-Jahannam hum se door rakh, woh to daimi aur lazmi azab hai. Jaise shayar ne Allah ki shaan batayi hai ke sher (In yu'azzibka gharaman wa in yu'ti jazilan fa innahu la yubali) yani is ke azab bhi sakht aur lazmi aur abadi aur us ki ata aur inaam bhi behad anginat aur besahab, jo cheez aaye aur hat jaye woh gharam nahin. Gharam woh hai jo aane ke baad hatne aur door hone ka naam hi na le. Yeh ma'ani bhi kiye gaye hain ke azab-e-Jahannam tawan hai jo kafiran-e-ni'mat se liya jayega. Unhon ne Allah ke diye ko us ki raah mein nahin lagaya lehaza aaj is ka tawan yeh bharna parega, Jahannam ko pur kar dein. Woh buri jagah hai, bad-manzar hai, takleef-deh hai, museebat-naak hai. Hazrat Malik bin Haris ka bayan hai ke jab dozakhi dozakh mein phenk diya jayega to Allah hi janta hai ke kitni muddat tak woh neeche hi neeche chala jayega, is ke baad Jahannam ke ek darwaze par use rok diya jayega aur kaha jayega tum bahut pyase ho rahe hoge, lo ek jaam to nosh kar lo. Yeh keh kar unhein kale naag aur zehreelay bichhuon ke zehar ka ek pyala pilaya jayega jis ke peete hi un ki khalein alag jhar jayengi, baal alag ho jayenge, ragein alag ja paren gi, haddiyan juda juda ho jayengi.

Phir apne nek bandon ka aur wasf bayan farmaya ke jab jahil log un se jahalat ki baatein karte hain toh yeh bhi un ki tarah jahalat par nahin utarte balkeh darguzar kar lete hain, maaf farma dete hain aur siwaye bhali baat ke gandi baton se apni zaban aalooda nahin karte. Jaise Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aadat-e-mubarak thi ke joon joon doosra aap par tez hota aap utne hi narm hote.

Momin log behuda baatein sun kar munh pher lete hain. Ek husn sanad se Musnad-e-Ahmad mein marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne kisi shakhs ne dusre ko bura bhala kaha lekin usne palat kar jawab diya ke tujh par salam ho. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tum dono ke darmiyan farishta majood tha woh teri taraf se gaaliyan dene wale ko jawab deta tha, woh jo gaali tujhe deta tha farishta kehta tha yeh nahin balkay tu, aur jab tu kehta tha tujh par salam to farishta kehta tha is par nahin balkay tujh par, tu hi salamti ka pura haqdar hai. Pas farman hai ke yeh apni zaban ko gandi nahin karte, bura kehne walon ko bura nahin kehte, siwaye bhale kalmay ke zaban se aur koi lafz nahin nikalte. Imam Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain dusra in par zulm kare yeh sulh aur bardasht karte hain. Allah ke bandon ke sath din is tarah guzarte hain ke un ki karwi kasili sun lete hain, raat ko jis halat mein guzarte hain us ka bayan agli aayat mein hai. Farmata hai ke raat Allah ki ibadat aur us ki ita'at mein basar hoti hai, bahut kam sote hain, subh ko istighfar karte hain, karwatein bistaron se alag rehti hain, dilon mein Allah ka khauf hota hai, umeed-e-rahmat hoti hai aur raton ki ghariyon ko Allah ki ibadaton mein guzarte hain. Duayein mangte hain ke Aye Allah azab-e-Jahannam hum se door rakh, woh to daimi aur lazmi azab hai. Jaise shayar ne Allah ki shaan batayi hai ke sher (In yu'azzibka gharaman wa in yu'ti jazilan fa innahu la yubali) yani is ke azab bhi sakht aur lazmi aur abadi aur us ki ata aur inaam bhi behad anginat aur besahab, jo cheez aaye aur hat jaye woh gharam nahin. Gharam woh hai jo aane ke baad hatne aur door hone ka naam hi na le. Yeh ma'ani bhi kiye gaye hain ke azab-e-Jahannam tawan hai jo kafiran-e-ni'mat se liya jayega. Unhon ne Allah ke diye ko us ki raah mein nahin lagaya lehaza aaj is ka tawan yeh bharna parega, Jahannam ko pur kar dein. Woh buri jagah hai, bad-manzar hai, takleef-deh hai, museebat-naak hai. Hazrat Malik bin Haris ka bayan hai ke jab dozakhi dozakh mein phenk diya jayega to Allah hi janta hai ke kitni muddat tak woh neeche hi neeche chala jayega, is ke baad Jahannam ke ek darwaze par use rok diya jayega aur kaha jayega tum bahut pyase ho rahe hoge, lo ek jaam to nosh kar lo. Yeh keh kar unhein kale naag aur zehreelay bichhuon ke zehar ka ek pyala pilaya jayega jis ke peete hi un ki khalein alag jhar jayengi, baal alag ho jayenge, ragein alag ja paren gi, haddiyan juda juda ho jayengi.

Imam Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain Allah ki raah mein kitna hi chaho do, us ka naam israf nahin hai. Farmata hai ke raat Allah ki ibadat aur us ki ita'at mein basar hoti hai, bahut kam sote hain, subh ko istighfar karte hain, karwatein bistaron se alag rehti hain, dilon mein Allah ka khauf hota hai, umeed-e-rahmat hoti hai aur raton ki ghariyon ko Allah ki ibadaton mein guzarte hain. Duayein mangte hain ke Aye Allah azab-e-Jahannam hum se door rakh, woh to daimi aur lazmi azab hai. Jaise shayar ne Allah ki shaan batayi hai ke sher (In yu'azzibka gharaman wa in yu'ti jazilan fa innahu la yubali) yani is ke azab bhi sakht aur lazmi aur abadi aur us ki ata aur inaam bhi behad anginat aur besahab, jo cheez aaye aur hat jaye woh gharam nahin. Gharam woh hai jo aane ke baad hatne aur door hone ka naam hi na le. Yeh ma'ani bhi kiye gaye hain ke azab-e-Jahannam tawan hai jo kafiran-e-ni'mat se liya jayega. Unhon ne Allah ke diye ko us ki raah mein nahin lagaya lehaza aaj is ka tawan yeh bharna parega, Jahannam ko pur kar dein. Woh buri jagah hai, bad-manzar hai, takleef-deh hai, museebat-naak hai. Hazrat Malik bin Haris ka bayan hai ke jab dozakhi dozakh mein phenk diya jayega to Allah hi janta hai ke kitni muddat tak woh neeche hi neeche chala jayega, is ke baad Jahannam ke ek darwaze par use rok diya jayega aur kaha jayega tum bahut pyase ho rahe hoge, lo ek jaam to nosh kar lo. Yeh keh kar unhein kale naag aur zehreelay bichhuon ke zehar ka ek pyala pilaya jayega jis ke peete hi un ki khalein alag jhar jayengi, baal alag ho jayenge, ragein alag ja paren gi, haddiyan juda juda ho jayengi.

Hazrat Ubaid bin Umair R.H farmate hain Jahannam mein garhay hain, kunwein hain, un mein saanp hain jaise Bakhti oont aur bichhoo hain jaise khachar. Jab kisi Jahannami ko Jahannam mein dala jata hai to woh wahan se nikal kar aate aur unhein lipat jate hain, honton par, saron par aur jism ke aur hisson par daste aur dank marte hain jis se un ke saare badan mein zehar phail jata hai aur phukne lagte hain, saare sar ki khaal jhulas kar gir padti hai phir woh saanp chale jate hain. Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke Jahannami ek hazaar saal tak Jahannam mein chillata rahega "Ya Hannan, Ya Mannan", tab Allah Ta'ala Hazrat Jibraeel A.S se farmayega jao dekho yeh kya keh raha hai. Hazrat Jibraeel A.S aakar dekhenge ke sab Jahannami buray haal sar jhukaye aah-o-zari kar rahe hain. Jakar Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein khabar karenge, Allah Ta'ala farmayega phir jao, falan falan jagah yeh shakhs hai, jao aur use le aao. Yeh ba-hukm-e-Ilahi jayenge aur use lakar samne khada kar denge. Allah Ta'ala us se daryaft farmayega ke tu kaisi jagah hai? Yeh jawab dega ke Aye Allah! Theherne ki bhi buri jagah aur sone baithne ki bhi badtareen jagah hai. Allah farmayega achha ab ise is ki jagah wapas le jao, to yeh gidgidaye ga, arz karega ke Aye mere Arham-ur-Rahimeen Allah! Jab ke tu ne mujhe is se bahar nikala to teri zaat aisi nahin ke phir mujhe is mein dakhil kar de, mujhe to tujh se raham-o-karam ki hi umeed hai. Aye Allah! Bas ab mujh par karam farma. Jab tu ne mujhe Jahannam se nikala to main khush ho gaya tha ke ab to is mein na dale ga. Us Malik-o-Rahman-o-Raheem Allah ko bhi raham aa jayega aur farmayega achha mere banday ko chhod do. Phir un ka ek aur wasf bayan hota hai ke woh na musrif hain na bakheel hain, na be-ja kharch karte hain na zaroori akhrajat mein kotahi karte hain balkay miana-rawi se kaam lete hain, na hi aisa karte hain ke apne walon ko, ahl-o-ayal ko bhi tang rakhein. Na aisa karte hain ke jo ho sab luta dein. Isi ka hukm Allah Ta'ala ne diya hai, farmata hai aayat (Wala taj'al yadaka maghloolatan ila unuqika wala tabsut-ha kullal basti fataq'uda maloomam mahsoora) (Al-Isra: 29) yani na to apne haath apni gardan se baandh aur na unhein bilkul hi chhod de. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein farman-e-Rasool hai ke apni guzran mein miana-rawi karna insaan ki samajh-dari ki daleel hai. Aur hadith mein hai jo ifrat-o-tafreet se bachta hai woh kabhi faqeer-o-mohtaj nahin hota. Bazzar ki hadith mein hai ke ameeri mein, faqiri mein, ibadat mein darmiyana-rawi badi hi behtar aur ahsan cheez hai. Imam Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain Allah ki raah mein kitna hi chaho do, us ka naam israf nahin hai. Hazrat Iyas bin Muawiyah R.H farmate hain jahan kahin tu hukm-e-Allah se aagay badh jaye wahi israf hai. Aur buzurgon ka qaul hai Allah ki nafarmani ka kharch israf kehlata hai.)

Sab se bada gunah: Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) ne sawal kiya ke sab se bada gunah kaunsa hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke tera Allah ke sath shirk karna. Halankeh isi akele ne tujhe paida kiya hai. Usne kaha is se kam? Farmaya tera apni aulad ko is khauf se maar dalna ke tu use khilaye ga kahan se? Poocha is ke baad? Farmaya tera apne pados ki kisi aurat se badkari karna. Pas is ki tasdeeq mein Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayatein nazil farmayin. Yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim waghera mein majood hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bahar jane lage tanha thay main bhi sath ho liya, aap ek oonchi jagah baith gaye main aap se neeche baith gaya aur is tanhai ke mauqa ko ghaneemat samajh kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se woh sawalat kiye jo oopar mazkoor huay. Hajjat-ul-Wida mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya char gunahon se bacho, Allah ke sath shirk, kisi hurmat walay nafs ka qatl, zinakari aur chori. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne as-haab (R.A) se poocha zina ki babat tum kya kehte ho? Unhon ne jawab diya woh haram hai aur woh Qayamat tak haram hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya han suno! Insaan ka apne pados ki aurat se zina karna dusri das aurton se zina se bhi badtar hai. Phir aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya chori ki nisbat kya kehte ho? Unhon ne yahi jawab diya ke woh haram hai, Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) isay haram qarar de chuke hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya suno das jagah ki chori bhi itni buri nahin jaisi pados ki ek jagah ki chori. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke shirk ke baad is se bada gunah koi nahin ke insaan apna nutfa us reham mein dale jo us ke liye halal nahin. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke baaz mushrikeen Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye aur kaha Hazrat aap ki dawat achi hai sachi hai lekin hum ne to shirk bhi kiya hai, qatl bhi kiya hai, zinakariyan bhi ki hain aur yeh sab kaam bakasrat kiye hain to farmayiye hamare liye kya hukum hai? Is par yeh ayat utri aur ayat (Qul ya ibadiyallazina asrafu ala anfusihim la taqnatu mir rahmatillah innallaha yaghfiruz zunuba jamia innahu huwal ghafoorur raheem) (Surah (Az-Zumar: 53) bhi nazil hui. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke Allah tumhein is se mana farmata hai ke tum khaliq ko chhor kar makhlooq ki ibadat karo aur is se bhi mana farmata hai ke apne kuttay ko to palo aur apne bachay ko qatl kar dalo. Aur is se bhi mana farmata hai ke apni padosan se badkari karo. Asam Jahannam ki ek wadi ka naam hai, yahi woh wadi hai jin mein zaniyon ko azab diya jaye ga. Is ke ma'ani azab-o-saza ke bhi aate hain. Hazrat Luqman Hakeem ki nasihaton mein hai ke ae bachay zinakari se bachna, is ke shuru mein dar khauf hai aur is ka anjam nadamat-o-hasrat hai. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke Ghayy aur Asam dozakh ke do kunwein hain, Allah hamein mehfooz rakhein. Asam ke ma'ani badlay ke bhi marwi hain aur yahi zahir-e-ayat ke mushaba bhi hai. Aur goya is ke baad ki ayat isi badlay aur saza ki tafseer hai.

Ke use baar baar azab kiya jaye ga aur sakhti ki jaye gi aur zillat ke daimi azabon mein phans jaye ga. (Allahumma ihfazna) In kamon ke karne wale ki saza toh bayan ho chuki hai, magar is saza se woh bach jayenge jo duniya hi mein tauba kar lein, Allah un ki tauba qabool farmaye ga. Is se maloom hota hai ke qatil ki tauba bhi qabool hoti hai jo aayat Surah Nisa mein hai (Waman yaqtul mu'minan muta'ammidan fajaza'uhu jahannamu khalidan fiha waghadiballahu alaihi wala'anahu wa'a'adda lahu azaban azima 93) (An-Nisa: 93), woh is ke khilaf nahin, go woh Madani aayat hai lekin woh mutlaq hai toh woh mahmool ki jaye gi un qatilon par jo apne is fe'l se tauba na karein aur yeh aayat un qatilon ke bare mein hai jo tauba karein. Phir mushrikon ki bakhshish na hone ka bayan farmaya hai aur sahih ahadith se bhi qatil ki tauba ki maqbooliyat sabit hai. Jaise us shakhs ka qissa jis ne ek sau qatl kiye thay phir tauba ki aur us ki tauba qabool hui. Woh log hain jin ki buraiyan Allah Ta'ala bhalaiyon se badal deta hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke yeh woh log hain jinhon ne Islam qabool karne se pehle gunah ke kaam kiye thay, Islam mein aane ke baad nekiyan keen toh Allah Ta'ala ne un gunah ke kamon ke badle nekiyon ki taufiq inayat farmayi. Is aayat ki tilawat ke waqt aap ek Arabi she'r parhte thay jis mein ahwal ke taghayyur ka bayan hai jaise garmi se thandak. Ata bin Abi Rabah farmate hain yeh duniya ka zikr hai ke insaan ki buri khaslat ko Allah Ta'ala apni meherbani se nek aadat se badal deta hai. Saeed bin Jubair ka bayan hai ke buton ki parastish ke badle Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat ki taufiq unhein mili. Mominon se larnay ke bajaye kafiron se jihad karne lage. Mushrika aurton se nikah ke bajaye momina aurton se nikah kiye. Hasan Basri farmate hain gunah ke badle sawab ke amal karne lage. Shirk ke badle tauheed-o-ikhlas mila. Badkari ke badle pakdamani hasil hui. Kufr ke badle Islam mila. Ek ma'ani toh is aayat ke yeh huye, dusre ma'ani yeh hain ke khuloos ke sath un ki jo tauba thi us se khush ho kar Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne un ke gunahon ko nekiyon mein badal diya. Yeh is liye ke tauba ke baad jab kabhi unhein apne guzashta gunah yaad aate thay unhein nadamat hoti thi, yeh ghamgeen ho jate thay, sharmane lagte thay aur istighfar karte thay. Is wajah se un ke gunah ita'at se badal gaye, go woh un ke nama-e-a'maal mein gunah ke taur par likhe huye thay lekin Qayamat ke din woh sab nekiyan ban jayengi jaise ke ahadith-o-asar mein sabit hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain main us shakhs ko pehchanta hoon jo sab se aakhir Jahannam se nikle ga aur sab se aakhir Jannat mein jaye ga, yeh ek woh shakhs hoga jise Allah ke samne laya jaye ga, Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga is ke bare bare gunahon ko chor kar chote chote gunahon ki nisbat is se baz purs karo, chunancha is se sawal hoga ke falan falan din tu ne falan kaam kiya tha? Falan din falan gunah kiya tha?

Yeh ek ka bhi inkar na kar sake ga iqrar kare ga. Aakhir mein kaha jaye ga tujhe hum ne har gunah ke badle neki di ab toh is ki baachhein khul jayengi aur kahe ga ae mere parwardigar main ne aur bhi bohat se aamal kiye thay jinhein yahan pa nahin raha. Yeh farma kar Huzoor ﷺ is qadar hanse ke aap ke masooray dekhe jaane lage (Muslim). Aap farmate hain ke jab insaan sota hai toh farishta shaitan se kehta hai mujhe apna sahifa jis mein is ke gunah likhe hue hain de, woh deta hai toh ek neki ke badle das das gunah woh is ke sahifay se mita deta hai aur unhein nekiyan likh deta hai, pas tum mein se jo bhi sone ka irada karein woh chountis dafa Allahu Akbar aur taintis dafa Alhamdulillah aur taintis dafa SubhanAllah kahe, yeh mil kar sau martaba ho gaye. (Ibn-e-Abi Dunya). Hazrat Salman R.A farmate hain insaan ko Qayamat ke din nama-e-aamal diya jaye ga, woh parhna shuru kare ga toh oopar hi is ki buraiyan darj hongi jinhein parh kar yeh kuch na-umeed sa hone lage ga. Isi waqt is ki nazar neeche ki taraf pare gi toh apni nekiyan likhi hui paye ga jis se kuch dharas bandhe gi. Ab dobara oopar ki taraf dekhe ga toh gunahon ki buraiyon ko bhi bhalaiyon se badla hua paye ga. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A farmate hain ke bohat se log Allah Ta'ala ke samne aayenge jin ke paas bohat kuch gunah honge, poocha gaya ke woh kaun se log honge? Aap ne farmaya ke woh jin ki buraiyon ko Allah Ta'ala bhalaiyon se badal de ga. Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal R.A farmate hain Jannati Jannat mein chaar qisam ke jayenge. Muttaqeen yani parhezgari karne wale, phir Shakireen yani shukr-e-Ilahi karne wale, phir Khaifeen yani khauf-e-Ilahi rakhne wale, phir Ashab-e-Yameen dayein haath mein nama-e-aamal paane wale. Poocha gaya ke unhein Ashab-e-Yameen kyun kaha jata hai? Jawab diya is liye ke unhon ne nekiyan badiyan sab ki thin, un ke aamal naame un ke dahne haath mile, apni badiyon ka ek ek harf parh kar yeh kehne lage ke ae Allah hamari nekiyan kahan hain? Yahan toh sab badiyan likhi hui hain, us waqt Allah Ta'ala in badiyon ko mita de ga aur un ke badle nekiyan likh de ga, unhein parh kar khush ho kar ab toh yeh dusron se kahenge ke aao hamare aamal naame dekho, Jannatiyon mein aksar yahi log honge. Imam Ali bin Hussain Zain-ul-Abideen farmate hain buraiyon ko bhalaiyon se badalna Aakhirat mein hoga. Makhool farmate hain Allah Ta'ala un ke gunahon ko bakhshe ga aur unhein nekiyon mein badal de ga. Hazrat Makhool ne ek martaba hadith bayan ki, ek bohat boorhay za'eef aadmi jin ki bhawen aankhon par aa gayi thin, Rasool Allah ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur arz karne lage ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main ek aisa shakhs hoon jis ne koi ghaddari, koi gunah, koi badkari baqi nahin chhori. Mere gunah is qadar barh gaye hain ke agar tamam insaanon par taqseem ho jayen toh sab ke sab ghazab-e-Ilahi mein giraftar ho jayen, kya meri bakhshish ki bhi koi surat hai? Kya meri tauba qabool ho sakti hai?

Aap ne farmaya ke tum Musalman ho jao, us ne kalma parh liya "Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluhu" to aap ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala teri tamam buraiyan, gunah, badkariyan sab kuch maaf farma de ga, balkeh jab tak tu is par qaim rahe ga Allah Ta'ala teri buraiyan bhalaiyon mein badal de ga. Us ne phir poocha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere chhotay baray gunah sab saaf ho jayen ge? Aap ne farmaya haan haan sab ke sab, phir to woh shakhs khushi khushi wapas janay laga aur takbeer-o-tahleel pukarta hua laut gaya. (R.A) (Ibn-e-Jarir). Hazrat Abu Farwah (R.A) hazir-e-huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ho kar arz karte hain ke agar kisi shakhs ne saray gunah kiye hon jo jee mein aaya ho poora kiya, kya aisay shakhs ki tauba bhi qabool ho sakti hai? Aap ne farmaya tum Musalman ho gaye ho? Us ne kaha jee haan, aap ne farmaya ab nekiyan karo buraiyon se bacho to Allah Ta'ala tumhare gunah bhi nekiyon mein badal de ga, us ne kaha meri ghaddariyan aur badkariyan bhi? Aap ne farmaya haan, ab woh Allahu Akbar kehta hua wapas chala gaya. (Tabrani). Ek aurat Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ke paas aayi aur daryaft farmaya ke mujh se badkari ho gayi, is se bacha ho gaya, main ne usay maar dala, ab kya meri tauba qabool ho sakti hai? Aap ne farmaya ke ab na teri aankhein thandi ho sakti hain na Allah ke haan teri buzurgi ho sakti hai, tere liye tauba hargiz nahin, woh roti peetti wapas chali gayi. Subah ki namaz huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath parh kar main ne yeh waqea bayan kiya to aap ne farmaya tu ne us se bohat hi buri baat kahi, kya tu in aayaton ko Quran mein nahin parhta? Ayat (Wallazeena la yad'oona ma'allahi ilahan aakhara wala yaqtulunan-nafsallati harramallahu illal-haqqi wala yaznoon, wa man yaf'al zalika yalqa asama) (Surah (Al-Furqan: 68) tak. Mujhe bara hi ranj hua aur main laut kar us aurat ke paas pahuncha aur usay yeh aayatein parh kar sunayin, woh khush ho gayi aur usi waqt sajday mein gir pari aur kehne lagi Allah ka shukr hai ke us ne mere liye chhutkaray ki soorat paida kar di. (Tabrani). Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ka pehla fatwa sun kar woh hasrat-o-afsos ke sath yeh kehti hui wapas chali ke haye haye yeh achi soorat kya jahannam ke liye banayi gayi thi? Is mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ko apni ghalti ka ilm hua woh us aurat ko dhoondne ke liye niklay, tamam Madina aur ek ek gali chhan maari lekin kahin pata na chala. Ittefaq se raat ko woh aurat phir aayi tab Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne unhein sahih masla batlaya. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke us ne Allah ki tareef karte hue kaha ke us ne mere liye chhutkaray ki soorat banayi aur meri tauba ko qabool farmaya, yeh keh kar us ke sath jo laundi thi usay azad kar diya, us laundi ki ek larki bhi thi aur sachay dil se tauba kar li.

Phir farmata hai aur apne aam lutf-o-karam, fazl-o-rahm ki khabar deta hai ke jo bhi Allah ki taraf jhuke aur apni siyah-kariyon par nadim ho kar tauba kare Allah uski sunta hai, qubool farmata hai aur use deta hai. Jaise irshad hai aayat: (وَمَنْ يَّعْمَلْ سُوْۗءًا اَوْ يَظْلِمْ نَفْسَهٗ ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرِ اللّٰهَ يَجِدِ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِيْمًا) (Surah (An-Nisa: 110) jo bura amal kare ya apni jaan par zulm kare phir tauba istighfar kare woh Allah ko Ghafoor-ur-Rahim payega. Aur jagah irshad hai aayat: (Alam ya'lamu annallaha yaqbalut-tawbata...) kya unhein yeh bhi nahin maloom ke Allah Ta'ala tauba ko qubool farmane wala hai. Aayat: (قُلْ يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسْرَفُوْا عَلٰٓي اَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ اللّٰهِ ۭ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ جَمِيْعًا ۭ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ) (Surah (Az-Zumar: 53) mere un bandon se jo gunahgar hain keh dijiye ke woh meri rahmat se na-umeed na hon. Ya'ni tauba karne wala mehroom nahin.))))

Yeh bhi marwi hai ke baaz mushrikeen Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye aur kaha Hazrat aap ki dawat achi hai sachi hai lekin hum ne to shirk bhi kiya hai, qatl bhi kiya hai, zinakariyan bhi ki hain aur yeh sab kaam bakasrat kiye hain to farmayiye hamare liye kya hukum hai? Is par yeh ayat utri aur ayat (Qul ya ibadiyallazina asrafu ala anfusihim la taqnatu mir rahmatillah innallaha yaghfiruz zunuba jamia innahu huwal ghafoorur raheem) (Surah (Az-Zumar: 53) bhi nazil hui. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke Allah tumhein is se mana farmata hai ke tum khaliq ko chhor kar makhlooq ki ibadat karo aur is se bhi mana farmata hai ke apne kuttay ko to palo aur apne bachay ko qatl kar dalo. Aur is se bhi mana farmata hai ke apni padosan se badkari karo. Asam Jahannam ki ek wadi ka naam hai, yahi woh wadi hai jin mein zaniyon ko azab diya jaye ga. Is ke ma'ani azab-o-saza ke bhi aate hain. Hazrat Luqman Hakeem ki nasihaton mein hai ke ae bachay zinakari se bachna, is ke shuru mein dar khauf hai aur is ka anjam nadamat-o-hasrat hai. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke Ghayy aur Asam dozakh ke do kunwein hain, Allah hamein mehfooz rakhein. Asam ke ma'ani badlay ke bhi marwi hain aur yahi zahir-e-ayat ke mushaba bhi hai. Aur goya is ke baad ki ayat isi badlay aur saza ki tafseer hai.

Ke use baar baar azab kiya jaye ga aur sakhti ki jaye gi aur zillat ke daimi azabon mein phans jaye ga. (Allahumma ihfazna) In kamon ke karne wale ki saza toh bayan ho chuki hai, magar is saza se woh bach jayenge jo duniya hi mein tauba kar lein, Allah un ki tauba qabool farmaye ga. Is se maloom hota hai ke qatil ki tauba bhi qabool hoti hai jo aayat Surah Nisa mein hai (Waman yaqtul mu'minan muta'ammidan fajaza'uhu jahannamu khalidan fiha waghadiballahu alaihi wala'anahu wa'a'adda lahu azaban azima 93) (An-Nisa: 93), woh is ke khilaf nahin, go woh Madani aayat hai lekin woh mutlaq hai toh woh mahmool ki jaye gi un qatilon par jo apne is fe'l se tauba na karein aur yeh aayat un qatilon ke bare mein hai jo tauba karein. Phir mushrikon ki bakhshish na hone ka bayan farmaya hai aur sahih ahadith se bhi qatil ki tauba ki maqbooliyat sabit hai. Jaise us shakhs ka qissa jis ne ek sau qatl kiye thay phir tauba ki aur us ki tauba qabool hui. Woh log hain jin ki buraiyan Allah Ta'ala bhalaiyon se badal deta hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke yeh woh log hain jinhon ne Islam qabool karne se pehle gunah ke kaam kiye thay, Islam mein aane ke baad nekiyan keen toh Allah Ta'ala ne un gunah ke kamon ke badle nekiyon ki taufiq inayat farmayi. Is aayat ki tilawat ke waqt aap ek Arabi she'r parhte thay jis mein ahwal ke taghayyur ka bayan hai jaise garmi se thandak. Ata bin Abi Rabah farmate hain yeh duniya ka zikr hai ke insaan ki buri khaslat ko Allah Ta'ala apni meherbani se nek aadat se badal deta hai. Saeed bin Jubair ka bayan hai ke buton ki parastish ke badle Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat ki taufiq unhein mili. Mominon se larnay ke bajaye kafiron se jihad karne lage. Mushrika aurton se nikah ke bajaye momina aurton se nikah kiye. Hasan Basri farmate hain gunah ke badle sawab ke amal karne lage. Shirk ke badle tauheed-o-ikhlas mila. Badkari ke badle pakdamani hasil hui. Kufr ke badle Islam mila. Ek ma'ani toh is aayat ke yeh huye, dusre ma'ani yeh hain ke khuloos ke sath un ki jo tauba thi us se khush ho kar Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne un ke gunahon ko nekiyon mein badal diya. Yeh is liye ke tauba ke baad jab kabhi unhein apne guzashta gunah yaad aate thay unhein nadamat hoti thi, yeh ghamgeen ho jate thay, sharmane lagte thay aur istighfar karte thay. Is wajah se un ke gunah ita'at se badal gaye, go woh un ke nama-e-a'maal mein gunah ke taur par likhe huye thay lekin Qayamat ke din woh sab nekiyan ban jayengi jaise ke ahadith-o-asar mein sabit hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain main us shakhs ko pehchanta hoon jo sab se aakhir Jahannam se nikle ga aur sab se aakhir Jannat mein jaye ga, yeh ek woh shakhs hoga jise Allah ke samne laya jaye ga, Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga is ke bare bare gunahon ko chor kar chote chote gunahon ki nisbat is se baz purs karo, chunancha is se sawal hoga ke falan falan din tu ne falan kaam kiya tha? Falan din falan gunah kiya tha?

Yeh ek ka bhi inkar na kar sake ga iqrar kare ga. Aakhir mein kaha jaye ga tujhe hum ne har gunah ke badle neki di ab toh is ki baachhein khul jayengi aur kahe ga ae mere parwardigar main ne aur bhi bohat se aamal kiye thay jinhein yahan pa nahin raha. Yeh farma kar Huzoor ﷺ is qadar hanse ke aap ke masooray dekhe jaane lage (Muslim). Aap farmate hain ke jab insaan sota hai toh farishta shaitan se kehta hai mujhe apna sahifa jis mein is ke gunah likhe hue hain de, woh deta hai toh ek neki ke badle das das gunah woh is ke sahifay se mita deta hai aur unhein nekiyan likh deta hai, pas tum mein se jo bhi sone ka irada karein woh chountis dafa Allahu Akbar aur taintis dafa Alhamdulillah aur taintis dafa SubhanAllah kahe, yeh mil kar sau martaba ho gaye. (Ibn-e-Abi Dunya). Hazrat Salman R.A farmate hain insaan ko Qayamat ke din nama-e-aamal diya jaye ga, woh parhna shuru kare ga toh oopar hi is ki buraiyan darj hongi jinhein parh kar yeh kuch na-umeed sa hone lage ga. Isi waqt is ki nazar neeche ki taraf pare gi toh apni nekiyan likhi hui paye ga jis se kuch dharas bandhe gi. Ab dobara oopar ki taraf dekhe ga toh gunahon ki buraiyon ko bhi bhalaiyon se badla hua paye ga. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A farmate hain ke bohat se log Allah Ta'ala ke samne aayenge jin ke paas bohat kuch gunah honge, poocha gaya ke woh kaun se log honge? Aap ne farmaya ke woh jin ki buraiyon ko Allah Ta'ala bhalaiyon se badal de ga. Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal R.A farmate hain Jannati Jannat mein chaar qisam ke jayenge. Muttaqeen yani parhezgari karne wale, phir Shakireen yani shukr-e-Ilahi karne wale, phir Khaifeen yani khauf-e-Ilahi rakhne wale, phir Ashab-e-Yameen dayein haath mein nama-e-aamal paane wale. Poocha gaya ke unhein Ashab-e-Yameen kyun kaha jata hai? Jawab diya is liye ke unhon ne nekiyan badiyan sab ki thin, un ke aamal naame un ke dahne haath mile, apni badiyon ka ek ek harf parh kar yeh kehne lage ke ae Allah hamari nekiyan kahan hain? Yahan toh sab badiyan likhi hui hain, us waqt Allah Ta'ala in badiyon ko mita de ga aur un ke badle nekiyan likh de ga, unhein parh kar khush ho kar ab toh yeh dusron se kahenge ke aao hamare aamal naame dekho, Jannatiyon mein aksar yahi log honge. Imam Ali bin Hussain Zain-ul-Abideen farmate hain buraiyon ko bhalaiyon se badalna Aakhirat mein hoga. Makhool farmate hain Allah Ta'ala un ke gunahon ko bakhshe ga aur unhein nekiyon mein badal de ga. Hazrat Makhool ne ek martaba hadith bayan ki, ek bohat boorhay za'eef aadmi jin ki bhawen aankhon par aa gayi thin, Rasool Allah ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur arz karne lage ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main ek aisa shakhs hoon jis ne koi ghaddari, koi gunah, koi badkari baqi nahin chhori. Mere gunah is qadar barh gaye hain ke agar tamam insaanon par taqseem ho jayen toh sab ke sab ghazab-e-Ilahi mein giraftar ho jayen, kya meri bakhshish ki bhi koi surat hai? Kya meri tauba qabool ho sakti hai?

Aap ne farmaya ke tum Musalman ho jao, us ne kalma parh liya "Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluhu" to aap ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala teri tamam buraiyan, gunah, badkariyan sab kuch maaf farma de ga, balkeh jab tak tu is par qaim rahe ga Allah Ta'ala teri buraiyan bhalaiyon mein badal de ga. Us ne phir poocha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere chhotay baray gunah sab saaf ho jayen ge? Aap ne farmaya haan haan sab ke sab, phir to woh shakhs khushi khushi wapas janay laga aur takbeer-o-tahleel pukarta hua laut gaya. (R.A) (Ibn-e-Jarir). Hazrat Abu Farwah (R.A) hazir-e-huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ho kar arz karte hain ke agar kisi shakhs ne saray gunah kiye hon jo jee mein aaya ho poora kiya, kya aisay shakhs ki tauba bhi qabool ho sakti hai? Aap ne farmaya tum Musalman ho gaye ho? Us ne kaha jee haan, aap ne farmaya ab nekiyan karo buraiyon se bacho to Allah Ta'ala tumhare gunah bhi nekiyon mein badal de ga, us ne kaha meri ghaddariyan aur badkariyan bhi? Aap ne farmaya haan, ab woh Allahu Akbar kehta hua wapas chala gaya. (Tabrani). Ek aurat Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ke paas aayi aur daryaft farmaya ke mujh se badkari ho gayi, is se bacha ho gaya, main ne usay maar dala, ab kya meri tauba qabool ho sakti hai? Aap ne farmaya ke ab na teri aankhein thandi ho sakti hain na Allah ke haan teri buzurgi ho sakti hai, tere liye tauba hargiz nahin, woh roti peetti wapas chali gayi. Subah ki namaz huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath parh kar main ne yeh waqea bayan kiya to aap ne farmaya tu ne us se bohat hi buri baat kahi, kya tu in aayaton ko Quran mein nahin parhta? Ayat (Wallazeena la yad'oona ma'allahi ilahan aakhara wala yaqtulunan-nafsallati harramallahu illal-haqqi wala yaznoon, wa man yaf'al zalika yalqa asama) (Surah (Al-Furqan: 68) tak. Mujhe bara hi ranj hua aur main laut kar us aurat ke paas pahuncha aur usay yeh aayatein parh kar sunayin, woh khush ho gayi aur usi waqt sajday mein gir pari aur kehne lagi Allah ka shukr hai ke us ne mere liye chhutkaray ki soorat paida kar di. (Tabrani). Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ka pehla fatwa sun kar woh hasrat-o-afsos ke sath yeh kehti hui wapas chali ke haye haye yeh achi soorat kya jahannam ke liye banayi gayi thi? Is mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ko apni ghalti ka ilm hua woh us aurat ko dhoondne ke liye niklay, tamam Madina aur ek ek gali chhan maari lekin kahin pata na chala. Ittefaq se raat ko woh aurat phir aayi tab Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne unhein sahih masla batlaya. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke us ne Allah ki tareef karte hue kaha ke us ne mere liye chhutkaray ki soorat banayi aur meri tauba ko qabool farmaya, yeh keh kar us ke sath jo laundi thi usay azad kar diya, us laundi ki ek larki bhi thi aur sachay dil se tauba kar li.

Phir farmata hai aur apne aam lutf-o-karam, fazl-o-rahm ki khabar deta hai ke jo bhi Allah ki taraf jhuke aur apni siyah-kariyon par nadim ho kar tauba kare Allah uski sunta hai, qubool farmata hai aur use deta hai. Jaise irshad hai aayat: (وَمَنْ يَّعْمَلْ سُوْۗءًا اَوْ يَظْلِمْ نَفْسَهٗ ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرِ اللّٰهَ يَجِدِ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِيْمًا) (Surah (An-Nisa: 110) jo bura amal kare ya apni jaan par zulm kare phir tauba istighfar kare woh Allah ko Ghafoor-ur-Rahim payega. Aur jagah irshad hai aayat: (Alam ya'lamu annallaha yaqbalut-tawbata...) kya unhein yeh bhi nahin maloom ke Allah Ta'ala tauba ko qubool farmane wala hai. Aayat: (قُلْ يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسْرَفُوْا عَلٰٓي اَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ اللّٰهِ ۭ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ جَمِيْعًا ۭ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ) (Surah (Az-Zumar: 53) mere un bandon se jo gunahgar hain keh dijiye ke woh meri rahmat se na-umeed na hon. Ya'ni tauba karne wala mehroom nahin.))))

Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke tera Allah ke sath shirk karna. Halankeh isi akele ne tujhe paida kiya hai. Usne kaha is se kam? Farmaya tera apni aulad ko is khauf se maar dalna ke tu use khilaye ga kahan se? Poocha is ke baad? Farmaya tera apne pados ki kisi aurat se badkari karna. Pas is ki tasdeeq mein Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayatein nazil farmayin. Yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim waghera mein majood hai. Hajjat-ul-Wida mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya char gunahon se bacho, Allah ke sath shirk, kisi hurmat walay nafs ka qatl, zinakari aur chori. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne as-haab (R.A) se poocha zina ki babat tum kya kehte ho? Unhon ne jawab diya woh haram hai aur woh Qayamat tak haram hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya han suno! Insaan ka apne pados ki aurat se zina karna dusri das aurton se zina se bhi badtar hai. Phir aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya chori ki nisbat kya kehte ho? Unhon ne yahi jawab diya ke woh haram hai, Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) isay haram qarar de chuke hain. Yahan toh sab badiyan likhi hui hain, us waqt Allah Ta'ala in badiyon ko mita de ga aur un ke badle nekiyan likh de ga, unhein parh kar khush ho kar ab toh yeh dusron se kahenge ke aao hamare aamal naame dekho, Jannatiyon mein aksar yahi log honge. Imam Ali bin Hussain Zain-ul-Abideen farmate hain buraiyon ko bhalaiyon se badalna Aakhirat mein hoga. Makhool farmate hain Allah Ta'ala un ke gunahon ko bakhshe ga aur unhein nekiyon mein badal de ga. Hazrat Makhool ne ek martaba hadith bayan ki, ek bohat boorhay za'eef aadmi jin ki bhawen aankhon par aa gayi thin, Rasool Allah ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur arz karne lage ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main ek aisa shakhs hoon jis ne koi ghaddari, koi gunah, koi badkari baqi nahin chhori. Mere gunah is qadar barh gaye hain ke agar tamam insaanon par taqseem ho jayen toh sab ke sab ghazab-e-Ilahi mein giraftar ho jayen, kya meri bakhshish ki bhi koi surat hai? Kya meri tauba qabool ho sakti hai?

Aap ne farmaya ke tum Musalman ho jao, us ne kalma parh liya "Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluhu" to aap ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala teri tamam buraiyan, gunah, badkariyan sab kuch maaf farma de ga, balkeh jab tak tu is par qaim rahe ga Allah Ta'ala teri buraiyan bhalaiyon mein badal de ga. Us ne phir poocha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere chhotay baray gunah sab saaf ho jayen ge? Aap ne farmaya haan haan sab ke sab, phir to woh shakhs khushi khushi wapas janay laga aur takbeer-o-tahleel pukarta hua laut gaya. (R.A) (Ibn-e-Jarir). Hazrat Abu Farwah (R.A) hazir-e-huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ho kar arz karte hain ke agar kisi shakhs ne saray gunah kiye hon jo jee mein aaya ho poora kiya, kya aisay shakhs ki tauba bhi qabool ho sakti hai? Aap ne farmaya tum Musalman ho gaye ho? Us ne kaha jee haan, aap ne farmaya ab nekiyan karo buraiyon se bacho to Allah Ta'ala tumhare gunah bhi nekiyon mein badal de ga, us ne kaha meri ghaddariyan aur badkariyan bhi? Aap ne farmaya haan, ab woh Allahu Akbar kehta hua wapas chala gaya. (Tabrani). Ek aurat Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ke paas aayi aur daryaft farmaya ke mujh se badkari ho gayi, is se bacha ho gaya, main ne usay maar dala, ab kya meri tauba qabool ho sakti hai? Aap ne farmaya ke ab na teri aankhein thandi ho sakti hain na Allah ke haan teri buzurgi ho sakti hai, tere liye tauba hargiz nahin, woh roti peetti wapas chali gayi. Subah ki namaz huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath parh kar main ne yeh waqea bayan kiya to aap ne farmaya tu ne us se bohat hi buri baat kahi, kya tu in aayaton ko Quran mein nahin parhta? Ayat (Wallazeena la yad'oona ma'allahi ilahan aakhara wala yaqtulunan-nafsallati harramallahu illal-haqqi wala yaznoon, wa man yaf'al zalika yalqa asama) (Surah (Al-Furqan: 68) tak. Mujhe bara hi ranj hua aur main laut kar us aurat ke paas pahuncha aur usay yeh aayatein parh kar sunayin, woh khush ho gayi aur usi waqt sajday mein gir pari aur kehne lagi Allah ka shukr hai ke us ne mere liye chhutkaray ki soorat paida kar di. (Tabrani). Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ka pehla fatwa sun kar woh hasrat-o-afsos ke sath yeh kehti hui wapas chali ke haye haye yeh achi soorat kya jahannam ke liye banayi gayi thi? Is mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ko apni ghalti ka ilm hua woh us aurat ko dhoondne ke liye niklay, tamam Madina aur ek ek gali chhan maari lekin kahin pata na chala. Ittefaq se raat ko woh aurat phir aayi tab Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne unhein sahih masla batlaya. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke us ne Allah ki tareef karte hue kaha ke us ne mere liye chhutkaray ki soorat banayi aur meri tauba ko qabool farmaya, yeh keh kar us ke sath jo laundi thi usay azad kar diya, us laundi ki ek larki bhi thi aur sachay dil se tauba kar li.

Phir farmata hai aur apne aam lutf-o-karam, fazl-o-rahm ki khabar deta hai ke jo bhi Allah ki taraf jhuke aur apni siyah-kariyon par nadim ho kar tauba kare Allah uski sunta hai, qubool farmata hai aur use deta hai. Jaise irshad hai aayat: (وَمَنْ يَّعْمَلْ سُوْۗءًا اَوْ يَظْلِمْ نَفْسَهٗ ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرِ اللّٰهَ يَجِدِ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِيْمًا) (Surah (An-Nisa: 110) jo bura amal kare ya apni jaan par zulm kare phir tauba istighfar kare woh Allah ko Ghafoor-ur-Rahim payega. Aur jagah irshad hai aayat: (Alam ya'lamu annallaha yaqbalut-tawbata...) kya unhein yeh bhi nahin maloom ke Allah Ta'ala tauba ko qubool farmane wala hai. Aayat: (قُلْ يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسْرَفُوْا عَلٰٓي اَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ اللّٰهِ ۭ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ جَمِيْعًا ۭ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ) (Surah (Az-Zumar: 53) mere un bandon se jo gunahgar hain keh dijiye ke woh meri rahmat se na-umeed na hon. Ya'ni tauba karne wala mehroom nahin.))))

Sab se bada gunah: Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) ne sawal kiya ke sab se bada gunah kaunsa hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke tera Allah ke sath shirk karna. Halankeh isi akele ne tujhe paida kiya hai. Usne kaha is se kam? Farmaya tera apni aulad ko is khauf se maar dalna ke tu use khilaye ga kahan se? Poocha is ke baad? Farmaya tera apne pados ki kisi aurat se badkari karna. Pas is ki tasdeeq mein Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayatein nazil farmayin. Yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim waghera mein majood hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bahar jane lage tanha thay main bhi sath ho liya, aap ek oonchi jagah baith gaye main aap se neeche baith gaya aur is tanhai ke mauqa ko ghaneemat samajh kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se woh sawalat kiye jo oopar mazkoor huay. Hajjat-ul-Wida mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya char gunahon se bacho, Allah ke sath shirk, kisi hurmat walay nafs ka qatl, zinakari aur chori. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne as-haab (R.A) se poocha zina ki babat tum kya kehte ho? Unhon ne jawab diya woh haram hai aur woh Qayamat tak haram hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya han suno! Insaan ka apne pados ki aurat se zina karna dusri das aurton se zina se bhi badtar hai. Phir aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya chori ki nisbat kya kehte ho? Unhon ne yahi jawab diya ke woh haram hai, Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) isay haram qarar de chuke hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya suno das jagah ki chori bhi itni buri nahin jaisi pados ki ek jagah ki chori. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke shirk ke baad is se bada gunah koi nahin ke insaan apna nutfa us reham mein dale jo us ke liye halal nahin. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke baaz mushrikeen Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye aur kaha Hazrat aap ki dawat achi hai sachi hai lekin hum ne to shirk bhi kiya hai, qatl bhi kiya hai, zinakariyan bhi ki hain aur yeh sab kaam bakasrat kiye hain to farmayiye hamare liye kya hukum hai? Is par yeh ayat utri aur ayat (Qul ya ibadiyallazina asrafu ala anfusihim la taqnatu mir rahmatillah innallaha yaghfiruz zunuba jamia innahu huwal ghafoorur raheem) (Surah (Az-Zumar: 53) bhi nazil hui. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke Allah tumhein is se mana farmata hai ke tum khaliq ko chhor kar makhlooq ki ibadat karo aur is se bhi mana farmata hai ke apne kuttay ko to palo aur apne bachay ko qatl kar dalo. Aur is se bhi mana farmata hai ke apni padosan se badkari karo. Asam Jahannam ki ek wadi ka naam hai, yahi woh wadi hai jin mein zaniyon ko azab diya jaye ga. Is ke ma'ani azab-o-saza ke bhi aate hain. Hazrat Luqman Hakeem ki nasihaton mein hai ke ae bachay zinakari se bachna, is ke shuru mein dar khauf hai aur is ka anjam nadamat-o-hasrat hai. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke Ghayy aur Asam dozakh ke do kunwein hain, Allah hamein mehfooz rakhein. Asam ke ma'ani badlay ke bhi marwi hain aur yahi zahir-e-ayat ke mushaba bhi hai. Aur goya is ke baad ki ayat isi badlay aur saza ki tafseer hai.

Ke use baar baar azab kiya jaye ga aur sakhti ki jaye gi aur zillat ke daimi azabon mein phans jaye ga. (Allahumma ihfazna) In kamon ke karne wale ki saza toh bayan ho chuki hai, magar is saza se woh bach jayenge jo duniya hi mein tauba kar lein, Allah un ki tauba qabool farmaye ga. Is se maloom hota hai ke qatil ki tauba bhi qabool hoti hai jo aayat Surah Nisa mein hai (Waman yaqtul mu'minan muta'ammidan fajaza'uhu jahannamu khalidan fiha waghadiballahu alaihi wala'anahu wa'a'adda lahu azaban azima 93) (An-Nisa: 93), woh is ke khilaf nahin, go woh Madani aayat hai lekin woh mutlaq hai toh woh mahmool ki jaye gi un qatilon par jo apne is fe'l se tauba na karein aur yeh aayat un qatilon ke bare mein hai jo tauba karein. Phir mushrikon ki bakhshish na hone ka bayan farmaya hai aur sahih ahadith se bhi qatil ki tauba ki maqbooliyat sabit hai. Jaise us shakhs ka qissa jis ne ek sau qatl kiye thay phir tauba ki aur us ki tauba qabool hui. Woh log hain jin ki buraiyan Allah Ta'ala bhalaiyon se badal deta hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke yeh woh log hain jinhon ne Islam qabool karne se pehle gunah ke kaam kiye thay, Islam mein aane ke baad nekiyan keen toh Allah Ta'ala ne un gunah ke kamon ke badle nekiyon ki taufiq inayat farmayi. Is aayat ki tilawat ke waqt aap ek Arabi she'r parhte thay jis mein ahwal ke taghayyur ka bayan hai jaise garmi se thandak. Ata bin Abi Rabah farmate hain yeh duniya ka zikr hai ke insaan ki buri khaslat ko Allah Ta'ala apni meherbani se nek aadat se badal deta hai. Saeed bin Jubair ka bayan hai ke buton ki parastish ke badle Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat ki taufiq unhein mili. Mominon se larnay ke bajaye kafiron se jihad karne lage. Mushrika aurton se nikah ke bajaye momina aurton se nikah kiye. Hasan Basri farmate hain gunah ke badle sawab ke amal karne lage. Shirk ke badle tauheed-o-ikhlas mila. Badkari ke badle pakdamani hasil hui. Kufr ke badle Islam mila. Ek ma'ani toh is aayat ke yeh huye, dusre ma'ani yeh hain ke khuloos ke sath un ki jo tauba thi us se khush ho kar Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne un ke gunahon ko nekiyon mein badal diya. Yeh is liye ke tauba ke baad jab kabhi unhein apne guzashta gunah yaad aate thay unhein nadamat hoti thi, yeh ghamgeen ho jate thay, sharmane lagte thay aur istighfar karte thay. Is wajah se un ke gunah ita'at se badal gaye, go woh un ke nama-e-a'maal mein gunah ke taur par likhe huye thay lekin Qayamat ke din woh sab nekiyan ban jayengi jaise ke ahadith-o-asar mein sabit hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain main us shakhs ko pehchanta hoon jo sab se aakhir Jahannam se nikle ga aur sab se aakhir Jannat mein jaye ga, yeh ek woh shakhs hoga jise Allah ke samne laya jaye ga, Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga is ke bare bare gunahon ko chor kar chote chote gunahon ki nisbat is se baz purs karo, chunancha is se sawal hoga ke falan falan din tu ne falan kaam kiya tha? Falan din falan gunah kiya tha?

Yeh ek ka bhi inkar na kar sake ga iqrar kare ga. Aakhir mein kaha jaye ga tujhe hum ne har gunah ke badle neki di ab toh is ki baachhein khul jayengi aur kahe ga ae mere parwardigar main ne aur bhi bohat se aamal kiye thay jinhein yahan pa nahin raha. Yeh farma kar Huzoor ﷺ is qadar hanse ke aap ke masooray dekhe jaane lage (Muslim). Aap farmate hain ke jab insaan sota hai toh farishta shaitan se kehta hai mujhe apna sahifa jis mein is ke gunah likhe hue hain de, woh deta hai toh ek neki ke badle das das gunah woh is ke sahifay se mita deta hai aur unhein nekiyan likh deta hai, pas tum mein se jo bhi sone ka irada karein woh chountis dafa Allahu Akbar aur taintis dafa Alhamdulillah aur taintis dafa SubhanAllah kahe, yeh mil kar sau martaba ho gaye. (Ibn-e-Abi Dunya). Hazrat Salman R.A farmate hain insaan ko Qayamat ke din nama-e-aamal diya jaye ga, woh parhna shuru kare ga toh oopar hi is ki buraiyan darj hongi jinhein parh kar yeh kuch na-umeed sa hone lage ga. Isi waqt is ki nazar neeche ki taraf pare gi toh apni nekiyan likhi hui paye ga jis se kuch dharas bandhe gi. Ab dobara oopar ki taraf dekhe ga toh gunahon ki buraiyon ko bhi bhalaiyon se badla hua paye ga. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A farmate hain ke bohat se log Allah Ta'ala ke samne aayenge jin ke paas bohat kuch gunah honge, poocha gaya ke woh kaun se log honge? Aap ne farmaya ke woh jin ki buraiyon ko Allah Ta'ala bhalaiyon se badal de ga. Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal R.A farmate hain Jannati Jannat mein chaar qisam ke jayenge. Muttaqeen yani parhezgari karne wale, phir Shakireen yani shukr-e-Ilahi karne wale, phir Khaifeen yani khauf-e-Ilahi rakhne wale, phir Ashab-e-Yameen dayein haath mein nama-e-aamal paane wale. Poocha gaya ke unhein Ashab-e-Yameen kyun kaha jata hai? Ibad-ur-Rahman ke ausaf: Ibad-ur-Rahman ke aur nek ausaf bayan ho rahe hain ke woh jhooti gawahi nahin dete yani shirk nahin karte, but-parasti se bachte hain, jhoot nahin bolte, fisq-o-fujoor nahin karte, kufr se alag rehte hain, laghw aur batil kamon se parhez karte hain, gana nahin sunte, mushrikon ki eidein nahin manate, khayanat nahin karte, buri majlison mein nashist nahin rakhte, sharabein nahin peete, sharab-khanon mein nahin jate, uski raghbat nahin karte. Hadith mein bhi hai ke sache momin ko chahiye ke us dastarkhwan par na baithe jis par daur-e-sharab chal raha ho aur yeh bhi matlab hai ke jhooti gawahi nahin dete. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Kya main tumhein sab se bada gunah bata doon? Teen dafa yahi farmaya. Sahaba (R.A) ne kaha: Haan Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam). Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Allah ke sath shirk karna, maa-baap ki nafarmani karna. Us waqt tak aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) takiya lagaye baithe hue the, ab is se alag ho kar farmane lage: Suno aur jhooti baat kehna, suno aur jhooti gawahi dena. Ise baar-baar farmate rahe yahan tak ke hum apne dil mein kehne lage, kaash Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ab khamosh ho jate. Zyada zahir lafzon se toh yeh hai ke woh jhoot ke paas nahin jate. Allah ke in buzurg bandon ka ek wasf yeh bhi hai ke Quran ki ayatein sun kar unke dil hil jate hain, unke iman aur tawakkul badh jate hain, bakhilaf kuffar ke ke un par Kalam-e-Ilahi ka asar nahin hota, woh apni bad-aamaliyon se baaz nahin rehte. Na apna kufr chhodte hain na sarkashi, tughyani aur jahalat-o-zalalat se baaz aate hain. Iman walon ke iman badh jate hain aur bimar dil walon ki gandagi ubhar aati hai, pas kafir Allah ki ayaton se behre aur andhe ho jate hain. In mominon ki halat inke bar-aks hai, na yeh haq se behre hain na haq se andhe hain. Sunte hain, samajhte hain, nafa hasil karte hain, apni islah karte hain. Aise bahut se log hain jo padhte toh hain lekin andha-pan behra-pan nahin chhodte. Hazrat Sha'bi (R.H) se sawal hua ke ek shakhs aata hai aur dusron ko sajde mein pata hai lekin use nahin maloom ke kis ayat ko padh kar sajda kiya hai? Toh kya woh bhi inke sath sajda kar le? Toh aap (R.H) ne yahi ayat padhi, yani sajda na kare is liye ke usne na sajde ki ayat padhi na suni na sochi, toh momin ka koi kaam andha-dhund na karna chahiye jab tak uske samne kisi cheez ki haqeeqat na ho use shamil na hona chahiye. Phir in buzurg bandon ki ek dua bayan hoti hai ke woh Allah Ta'ala se talab karte hain ke unki auladein bhi unki tarah Rabb ki farman-bardar, ibadat-guzar, muwahhid aur ghair-mushrik hon, taake duniya mein bhi is nek aulad se unka dil thanda rahe aur aakhirat mein bhi yeh unhein achi halat mein dekh kar khush hon. Is dua se unki gharz khubsurti aur jamal nahin balki neki aur khush-khulqi ki hai. Musalman ki sachi khushi isi mein hai ke woh apne ahl-o-ayal ko, dost-ahbab ko Allah ka farman-bardar dekhe. Woh zalim na ho, badkar na ho, sache musalman hon.

Hazrat Miqdad R.A ko dekh kar ek sahib farmane lage in ki aankhon ko mubarak baad ho jinhon ne Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ki ziyarat ki hai. Kaash ke hum bhi Huzoor ﷺ ko dekhte aur tumhari tarah faiz-e-sohbat hasil karte. Is par Hazrat Miqdad R.A naraz hue to Nufeir kehte hain mujhe ta'ajjub maloom hua ke is baat mein koi burai nahin phir yeh khafa kyun ho rahe hain? Itne mein Hazrat Miqdad R.A ne farmaya ke logon ko kya ho gaya hai ke is cheez ki aarzoo karte hain ke jo qudrat ne unhein nahin di. Allah hi ko ilm hai ke yeh agar us waqt hote to in ka kya haal hota? Wallah woh log bhi to Rasool Allah ﷺ ke zamane mein the jinhon ne na Aap ki tasdeeq ki na tabedari ki aur oondhe munh jahannam mein gaye. Tum Allah ka yeh ehsan nahin maante ke Allah ne tumhein Islam mein aur musalman gharon mein paida kiya. Paida hote hi tumhare kaanon mein Allah ki tauheed aur Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ ki risalat padi aur in balaon se tum bacha liye gaye jo tum se agle logon par aayi thin. Huzoor ﷺ to aise zamane mein mab'oos hue the jis waqt duniya ki andher nagri apni inteha par thi. Us waqt duniya walon ke nazdeek but parasti se behtar koi mazhab na tha. Aap Furqan le kar aaye haq-o-batil mein tameez ki. Baap bete juda ho gaye. Musalman apne baap dadon, beton, poton, dost ahbab ko kufr par dekhte un se unhein koi mohabbat pyar nahin hota tha balkay kudhte the ke yeh jahannami hain isi liye un ki duayen hoti thin. Is dua ka aakhir yeh hai ke hamein logon ka rehbar bana de ke hum unhein neki ki taleem dein, log bhalai mein hamari iqtida karein. Hamari aulad hamari raah chale taake sawab badh jaye aur un ki nekiyon ka baais bhi hum ban jayen. Rasool-e-Kareem Alaihis Salatu Wattasleem farmate hain ke insaan ke marte hi us ke aamal khatam ho jate hain magar teen cheezein. Nek aulad jo us ke liye dua kare ya ilm jis se us ke baad nafa uthaya jaye ya sadqa-e-jariya.
